new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Signia Aerospace is a global, integrated provider of high-performance systems and specialized components for the aerospace industry. Signia designs, manufactures, and services a wide range of products, that include mission equipment, thermal management systems, engine technology, and propellers. The Signia brands are leaders in their respective markets and provide a compelling value proposition to both aerospace and defense OEMs and end-users.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Onboard Systems Hoist & Winch, located in Anaheim, CA is one of the world’s leading providers of Search & Rescue (SAR) and Human External Cargo (HEC) advanced mission equipment for civil, commercial, and military helicopters.
 
 
The Director of Quality is a key leadership position reporting directly to the General Manager (GM), responsible for establishing and executing the company's overall quality strategy. This role provides strategic direction and oversight of the Quality function, ensuring the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS), compliance with AS9100 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, and continuous improvement across all business operations. As the designated FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, the Director has authority over all Part 145 repair-station operations, ensures personnel follow applicable FAA regulations, and serves as the primary contact with the FAA. The Director also partners with executive and operational leadership to drive quality performance, manage organizational risk, and foster a company-wide culture of quality and accountability.
 
 
**Location:**
Anaheim, CA (on-site)
 
 
**Schedule:**
Monday - Friday
 
 
**Pay:**
$180,000 - $225,000, plus bonus eligibility
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Quality Management System Leadership
* Establish quality strategy, policies, and measurable objectives aligned with the company's business goals.
* Own and administer the company-wide Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100 (which incorporates ISO 9001) and applicable customer and regulatory requirements, including FAA and, where applicable, EASA requirements.
* Oversee the FAA Part 145 repair-station quality control system, including the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, Operations Specifications, and documented inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Ensure the QMS is effective, scalable, consistently deployed across the business, and aligned with the company's growth and product roadmap
* Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives to optimize quality processes, procedures, documentation, and controls.
* Manage document control and maintain accurate, controlled quality procedures, process documentation, and compliance records.
* Compliance & Customer Support
* Serve as the primary point of contact for external audits, including AS9100 certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory assessments.
* Prepare the organization for audits and lead audit responses, corrective actions, and follow-up activities to verify effective closure.
* Build and maintain credibility and trust with executive stakeholders, aerospace OEM customers, auditors, regulatory officials, and relevant industry partners.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable standards, customer requirements, and contractual quality clauses.
* Oversee incoming, in-process, and final manufacturing inspections, including first article inspection (FAI) activities to AS9102 when required by contract or approved procedures, while maintaining distinct FAA Part 145 maintenance-inspection and return-to-service controls.
* Quality Assurance
* Ensure timely containment and investigation of quality issues using methods such as A3, 8D, and 5 Whys, with documented root cause and corrective action (RCCA).
* Support Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams with timely quality guidance and issue resolution.
* Establish quality KPIs and targets, monitor trends, and report performance and improvement plans to the GM and leadership team.
* Use data-driven insights to improve customer satisfaction, compliance, and product consistency; reduce defects and cost of poor quality (COPQ); and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate product safety, airworthiness, quality, and compliance risks; escalate significant issues to leadership and track mitigation actions to closure.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for nonconforming product and airworthiness concerns; prevent unauthorized product release and ensure release decisions remain with appropriately authorized personnel.
* Lead internal audits and management reviews to ensure ongoing system effectiveness.
* Provide technical leadership and ensure team competency in precision metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Lead a risk-based supplier quality program covering supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and supplier corrective-action follow-up.
* Cross-functional Collaboration and Team Leadership
* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Program teams to embed quality into design, production, and supplier processes.
* Support new product introduction (NPI) with quality planning, risk assessments, and validation activities.
* Lead and develop the Quality team through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the organization through training, mentorship, and leadership by example.

**Who You Are**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of aerospace quality experience, including senior leadership responsibilities and significant responsibility for AS9100-based quality systems.
* Deep working knowledge of aerospace quality principles and requirements.
* Experience working with major aerospace OEMs and their quality expectations.
* Demonstrated experience leading internal, customer, and third-party certification or regulatory audits.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, discipline, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and communicate effectively with customers, auditors, and executive leadership.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a small, high-impact Quality team.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Working knowledge of 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, including the distinction between production airworthiness approvals and maintenance return to service, and applicable FAA Form 8130-3 issuance and signatory-authorization requirements.
* Experience with FAA-certificated Part 145 repair-station requirements, including regulatory interface and oversight of inspection and return-to-service controls.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of metallurgy and material certification review.
* AS9100 lead auditor training or equivalent demonstrated experience leading aerospace QMS audits.
* Background supporting NPI, supplier quality, and manufacturing quality operations.
* An advanced degree in a related discipline.
* ASQ or other relevant quality certifications, such as CQE or CQA.

**What’s In It For You**

* Competitive salary with annual bonus eligibility.
* Benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer contribution matching.
* In addition to offering competitive wages and benefits, Onboard Systems offers the opportunity to increase future earnings tied to growth in company performance. We recognize employee contributions toward growing the business through our Growth Participation Unit (GPU) program. GPUs are tied directly to company growth and reward all eligible employees with cash when the business grows over time.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status*

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements.
 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site’s AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification.
 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense).
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
• Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
 
• Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
 
• Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
 
• Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
 
• Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
 
• Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
 
• Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
 
• Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
 
• Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
 
• Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
 
• Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
 
• Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
 
• Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.
 
 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
 
• 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
 
• Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
 
• Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Salary Range: $140,000 USD - $180,000 USD

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

View our Privacy Policy

new_roles.description:
Location: 203A Log Canoe Circle, Stevensville, MD 21666
 
 
Shift Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday
 
 
Pay Range: $135,000 -175,000 + Bonus Eligibility!
 
 
**Hydrasearch,**
a proud affiliate of The Dixon Group, is looking for a
**Director of Quality Assurance**
to join our team in
**Stevensville, MD**
! The Director of Quality Assurance will lead the organization's quality management strategy and ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. This role is responsible for overseeing quality assurance programs, driving continuous improvement initiatives, managing quality personnel, and partnering with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to maintain high standards of product quality and operational excellence.
 
 
**At Hydrasearch, we value the contributions of our Military Veterans and proudly employ our nation’s heroes. Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.**
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance function across the organization.
* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with AS9100D and ISO 9001, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Establish quality objectives, metrics, and reporting processes to drive continuous improvement.
* Oversee internal audits, external audits, and customer quality assessments.
* Manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs and root cause analysis initiatives.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership to improve product and process quality.
* Analyze quality data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint investigations and resolution efforts.
* Develop and drive supplier quality programs. Actively work with vendors to address quality concerns.
* Build, mentor, and develop quality personnel and future leaders within the organization.
* Support new product introduction activities by ensuring quality standards are incorporated into design and manufacturing processes.
* Prepare and present quality performance updates to executive leadership.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field required; Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within manufacturing, maritime & aerospace defense, industrial, or related industries required; experience supporting defense, military, or government-contract manufacturing environments preferred.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality teams and managing direct reports.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100D & ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Demonstrated success implementing continuous improvement programs and driving measurable results.
* Experience with root cause analysis methodologies and corrective action processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control methodologies is a plus!
* This hands-on leadership position requires extensive maritime and aerospace defense quality experience, strong knowledge of industry standards and regulations, and proven success managing external audits and compliance initiatives.

**What We Offer**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
* Competitive salary
* Bonus programs
* 401K retirement plan
* Training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement
* Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
* Gym reimbursements, and more!

**Who We Are:**
Hydrasearch is a U.S. manufacturer specializing in fluid-transfer and control systems for maritime, aerospace, and defense applications. Since its founding in 1962, Hydrasearch has developed capabilities in hose assemblies, valve fittings, and customer machined parts, often to meet MIL-SPEC and naval standards.
 
 
**Join us and be a part of a team that values your contributions and supports your goals!**
**We do not provide sponsorships to work in the United States.**

It is the Company's policy and practice to recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals, as well as to administer all personnel actions, compensation, and benefits, without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, ancestry or national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, veteran status, military service, or any other factors protected by applicable law. This policy extends to all employees and applicants and to all aspects of the employment relationship.
 
 
The Dixon Group is committed to protecting the privacy rights of its employees and job applicants to the fullest extent required by applicable law. To that end, personal information will be collected solely for those legitimate business purposes recognized by law, and then maintained in a manner consistent with all applicable laws and regulations pertaining to document retention requirements. The Dixon Group does not sell personal information to third parties, and does not share such personal information with third parties except when authorized by law to do so (e.g., in response to a lawful subpoena; mandatory tax reporting; etc.)

new_roles.title: Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Business Unit:**
Miltope Corporation

**Location:**
Hope Hull, AL

This position is an exempt salaried role that normally works a 9/80 work schedule. Non-duty hours work may be required based on business needs.

**Who YOU are and what YOU can become:**

You are a high-performing strategist with a commitment to excellence, attention to detail, and a knack for identifying areas of improvement. You are looking for a role that serves a noble purpose: supporting our nation's warfighters.

**Who WE are and where WE are going:**

At ST Engineering North America Government, Miltope Corporation, we apply technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives. Our dedication to excellence has earned us a reputation for quality and trust as a global technology, defense, and engineering group. Our diverse portfolio spans aerospace, smart city, defense, and public security.

**What YOU will do:**

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

This position is responsible for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of quality management systems supporting, but not limited to:

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure regulatory requirements are implemented, monitored, and maintained.

The successful candidate must establish an effective quality culture while possessing the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

* Maintain responsibility for quality management system effectiveness and compliance supporting FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are communicated and implemented.
* Monitor regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined.

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee FAA Production Approval compliance, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with applicable manuals and Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the independence, authority, resources, and organizational access necessary to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective relationships with FAA, EASA, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management, including qualification, monitoring, and corrective actions.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance.

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

* Report directly to the CEO/President on regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective actions.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring.
* Escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including initiating product or maintenance holds and preventing release or return to service when requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement and sustain corrective actions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of quality system effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.
* Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customer representatives.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA systems, supplier quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, regulatory authorities, customers, and employees at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience overseeing multiple regulatory approvals or certifications within a single organization.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing and component repair/maintenance operations.
* Experience serving as or directly supporting a Part 21 Accountable Manager, FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, or EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 certification audits and aerospace customer audits.
* Experience implementing and maintaining risk-based quality systems and safety management processes.
* Experience managing quality organizations across multiple facilities or operating locations.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Independence, integrity, and willingness to address difficult quality and regulatory issues.
* Ability to influence executive leadership and operational management.
* Strong technical judgment and understanding of aviation product safety and airworthiness.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing compliance issues.
* Ability to balance regulatory requirements with practical business and operational considerations.
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to engage in the details.

**Measures of Success**

* Sustained compliance with FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 requirements.
* Successful completion of regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.
* Timely and effective resolution of audit findings and corrective actions.
* Effective quality system performance and reduction of recurring nonconformances.
* Strong organizational understanding of quality responsibilities and regulatory requirements.
* An independent, empowered Quality organization that supports business performance while protecting product conformity, airworthiness, and regulatory compliance.

**Please contact:**
Human Resources at hr@miltope.com

It takes diverse talent to solve real-world problems. ST Engineering/Miltope Corporation is deeply committed to building a workplace community where inclusion is valued and everyone feels welcomed. We are proud to consider all qualified applicants for employment. Miltope is an equal opportunity employer.

Miltope Corporation is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

new_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location:**
Springhill, TN or St. Louis, MO

**Position:**
Full-Time | Department Leadership Team

**Company Overview**

Our client is an established, growing manufacturing company specializing in custom-engineered components and solutions. With multiple manufacturing locations, the organization is committed to operational excellence, exceptional customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Quality to lead and oversee all aspects of quality management across a multi-location manufacturing organization.

This position serves as the company's senior quality leader, with overall responsibility for developing and executing the corporate quality strategy, maintaining the existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, and leading the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification.

The Director of Quality will provide leadership, direction, and professional development to all Quality Department personnel, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.

The ideal candidate will have extensive manufacturing quality experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record of developing quality systems, improving operational performance, and building high-performing teams.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership & Management**

* Provide company-wide leadership and oversight of all quality-related activities across the organization's manufacturing operations.
* Lead, mentor, develop, and manage the corporate Quality Department, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.
* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy, objectives, policies, and performance standards.
* Foster a proactive culture of quality, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to ensure quality objectives align with business and customer requirements.
* Develop organizational capabilities, staffing plans, and employee training programs to support current operations and future growth.

**Quality Management Systems & Certification**

* Maintain and continuously improve the company's existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing compliance, audit readiness, and successful maintenance of current certification.
* Develop and manage a comprehensive IATF 16949 certification roadmap, including gap assessments, implementation milestones, resource requirements, training, internal audits, and certification readiness.
* Ensure the company's Quality Management System (QMS) is enhanced to satisfy IATF 16949 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Lead and execute the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification within established timelines.
* Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes across all manufacturing locations.
* Oversee internal, external, customer, and certification audits, ensuring ongoing compliance and successful certification.
* Serve as, or provide leadership to, the company's Lead Auditor and internal audit teams.
* Ensure effective management of corrective and preventive actions, nonconformances, documentation, calibration, and quality records.
* Lead management reviews and ensure ongoing QMS effectiveness and organizational accountability.

**Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and drive improvements in company-wide Quality KPIs, including customer complaints, internal and external PPM, cost of poor quality, scrap, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives designed to reduce defects, improve manufacturing performance, and strengthen customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex problem-solving and root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams, FMEA, and statistical analysis.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality tools to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to establish effective process controls, inspection standards, and preventive quality measures.
* Oversee product nonconformance management, containment, material disposition, and corrective action activities.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Serve as the senior quality representative for key customer relationships, audits, escalations, and quality-related concerns.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of customer complaints and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Manage the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), working closely with internal Quality and Business Development teams to ensure timely completion of customer approvals and achievement of new business launch schedules.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Purchasing to establish supplier quality expectations, manage supplier performance, and resolve supplier-related quality issues.
* Support new customer onboarding, new product launches, and manufacturing process changes to ensure quality requirements are achieved.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve quality performance.

**Strategic & Operational Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute long-term quality improvement plans aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Establish standardized quality processes, reporting, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Support business expansion, new manufacturing capabilities, and potential acquisitions through quality system assessments and integration.
* Evaluate and recommend investments in inspection equipment, measurement technology, automation, and quality management systems.
* Prepare and present quality performance reports, improvement plans, certification progress, and key initiatives to executive leadership.
* Promote a safe work environment and ensure quality-related activities support company safety standards.
* Perform other quality-related leadership responsibilities as required.

**Experience & Education Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and significant manufacturing quality leadership experience.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including at least 3–5 years in a quality management or leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and/or plant-level quality personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 Quality Management Systems, implementation, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining ISO 9001-certified Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting or leading IATF 16949 implementation, certification preparation, or certification audits.
* Lead Auditor experience with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.
* Proven success improving quality performance, reducing defects, managing customer complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Experience managing customer and third-party quality audits.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, ERP/MRP systems, and quality-related software.
* Ability and willingness to travel between manufacturing locations and customer or supplier facilities as necessary.
* Must be physically based in the Nashville, TN, or St. Louis, MO, metropolitan area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience successfully leading an organization through IATF 16949 certification.
* Experience in automotive manufacturing, converting, or the production of engineered components and materials.
* Experience overseeing quality functions across multiple manufacturing facilities.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience implementing quality systems in a growing, multi-location manufacturing organization.
* Experience with supplier development, new product launches, and quality system integration.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and personal integrity.
* A hands-on, proactive leadership style with the ability to develop and inspire teams.
* The ability to balance strategic leadership with practical, day-to-day problem-solving.
* Strong customer focus and a commitment to delivering exceptional quality.
* An analytical, data-driven mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* A forward-thinking attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to challenge existing processes to achieve better results.
* A commitment to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and organizational success.

new_roles.description:
**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.
* Use and train in the following quality tools – root cause analysis and problem solving, FMEA, control plans, PPAP, APQP, System audits, SPC.
* Read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Working knowledge and development of quality systems and requirements and how they relate to business (i.e. AS9100, NADCAP).
* Identify and/or lead initiatives to improve Quality system compliance.
* Effective leadership skills and ability to influence department and peers, as well as be a team player.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to quality team, and will be responsible for the selection, motivation and oversight of the team for the achievement of the company goals.
* Assure all Quality staff are properly trained with the necessary equipment to yield consistent results.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor
* Occasional weekend and evening work may be required to accommodate priorities, deadlines, and schedules.

**Acknowledgements**
The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.
 
 
**Benefits**
Pursuit Aerospace also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements, among other things.
 
 
Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, skills, experience, and other job-related factors.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pursuit Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We adhere to all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.
* Use and train in the following quality tools – root cause analysis and problem solving, FMEA, control plans, PPAP, APQP, System audits, SPC.
* Read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Working knowledge and development of quality systems and requirements and how they relate to business (i.e. AS9100, NADCAP).
* Identify and/or lead initiatives to improve Quality system compliance.
* Effective leadership skills and ability to influence department and peers, as well as be a team player.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to quality team, and will be responsible for the selection, motivation and oversight of the team for the achievement of the company goals.
* Assure all Quality staff are properly trained with the necessary equipment to yield consistent results.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor
* Occasional weekend and evening work may be required to accommodate priorities, deadlines, and schedules.

**Acknowledgements**
The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.
 
 
**Benefits**
Pursuit Aerospace also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements, among other things.
 
 
Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, skills, experience, and other job-related factors.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pursuit Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We adhere to all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Director, Quality Assurance**

**Onsite in Warren, NJ**

**Full-Time**

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for the organization. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at company (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Will have 6 direct reports.
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by company, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout company
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service-oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Management - Inpatient Rehab
new_roles.description:
**Hospital Name: Ohiohealth Rehabilitation Hospital**
**Joint venture/Partnership/Affiliation with Select Medical**
**Position:**
**Director of Quality Management**
**Location: Dublin, OH**

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**
Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas
 
 
Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.
 
 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in Quality Improvement, with Statistical Process Control experience and computer skills preferred.
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including JCAHO and CARF preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred

new_roles.title: Quality Technical Director
new_roles.description:
Own the division’s quality strategy end-to-end, ensuring product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance work together to protect quality and meet regulatory expectations.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set technical and quality direction, translating business goals into practical standards, processes, and performance measures across the value chain.
* Build and lead a high-performing quality organization, coaching teams in root-cause problem solving, risk management, and documentation discipline.
* Strengthen supplier quality through performance reviews, issue containment expectations, and clear escalation paths.
* Lead investigation and resolution of customer quality issues, coordinating internal stakeholders to deliver effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement to enhance product performance and operational effectiveness, identifying systemic gaps and verifying outcomes.

**What You Bring**
Deep experience in quality systems and product safety, strong technical leadership, and a pragmatic approach to compliance and cross-functional execution—able to turn complex investigations into durable improvements.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance & CI
new_roles.description:
**Lead the Transformation. Build a Culture of Excellence. Deliver Results That Last.**
The Director of Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement provides strategic leadership for the company's quality and continuous improvement functions, ensuring products, processes, and services consistently meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) while driving a culture of operational excellence across the organization. Leading enterprise-wide Lean initiatives, Kaizen events, root cause analysis, and structured continuous improvement programs, this position delivers measurable improvements in quality, productivity, cost, and operational performance. Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams, the Director establishes quality strategies, drives compliance with customer and regulatory requirements, and champions sustainable improvements that support the company's strategic growth objectives.
 
 
**What Success Looks Like**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry standards, including ISO certifications.
* Establish enterprise-wide quality strategies, policies, and governance while serving as the executive leader for quality-related decisions impacting customers, operations, and suppliers.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence by leading Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured continuous improvement initiatives across all business functions.
* Develop and execute strategic cost reduction initiatives that improve productivity, eliminate waste, reduce the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), and enhance overall operational performance.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, and executive leadership to identify, prioritize, and deliver sustainable business improvements.
* Champion the voice of the customer by leveraging customer feedback, warranty data, and field performance to improve product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead enterprise-wide root cause analysis and corrective action processes to resolve quality issues, prevent recurrence, and strengthen operational performance.
* Oversee internal and external audit programs, ensuring compliance with quality, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements while proactively managing organizational risk.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality and Continuous Improvement organization while coaching leaders throughout the business to embed a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure quality, delivery, cost savings, productivity, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement performance.
* Translate strategic business objectives into measurable quality and operational improvement initiatives that deliver sustainable financial and operational results.
* Build trusted relationships across the organization and with external stakeholders, influencing decision-making and driving alignment to achieve the company's strategic objectives.

**Qualifications That Shine**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master's degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience, including 10+ years leading people and 5+ years leading corporate or multi-site quality organizations.
* Proven success developing and leading Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a manufacturing environment, including ISO implementation, certification, and ongoing compliance.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, and Lean certification are strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading Lean transformation, Kaizen events, and enterprise-wide continuous improvement initiatives that deliver measurable business results.
* Strong knowledge of quality systems, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), statistical process control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership and build collaborative partnerships across operations, engineering, supply chain, finance, and commercial teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and organizational skills with the ability to translate strategy into execution and drive organizational change.
* Strategic, data-driven leader with a track record of improving quality, operational performance, customer satisfaction, and financial results through operational excellence initiatives.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* You’ll Be Empowered – You’ll have autonomy in your role, supported by a team that trusts your judgment
* You’ll Grow With Us – We invest in your training, development, and long-term career path
* You’ll Be Rewarded – Competitive pay, performance incentives, 401(k) with profit sharing, and great benefits
* You’ll Make a Real Impact – Your work supports businesses across North America and shapes the future of finishing technology
* You’ll Join a Great Team – We’re growing fast, we value collaboration, and are committed to your success

**Transparent Rewards**
At GFS, we recognize the dedication behind every role and ensure that our compensation reflects both your impact and our shared success.
 
 
**Pay Range:**
$124,518 – $156,746 per year, based on your experience, skills, and qualifications.
 
 
**Bonus Eligibility:**
This position is eligible for an annual individual incentive based on company performance. Maximum bonus amounts may vary depending on role.
 
 
**Benefits:**
Eligible for standard company benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, paid time off, and other employee programs. More detailed information is available at 2026 GFS Benefits .
 
 
Actual compensation will be determined by factors including experience, education, certifications, skill level, and market conditions. For remote or hybrid positions, the listed pay range applies to applicants in the specified location.
 
 
**About GFS**
Global Finishing Solutions is the leading manufacturer of paint booths and finishing systems serving automotive, aerospace, industrial manufacturing, marine, military, rail, trucking, and wood finishing markets. We specialize in building custom solutions that meet each customer’s unique needs—and we do it with a team that thrives on collaboration and innovation because we're different.
 
 
What makes us different is our unwavering commitment to our core values of family, respect, partnership, improvement, and integrity. We are a family-oriented organization that still values the little things, creating a workplace where you can thrive, fairness guides every decision, and collaboration drives shared success. Small town in spirit but big-hearted in impact, here you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a team that grows together, celebrates together, and builds lasting value together. That’s the difference. Join us.
 
 
Apply now at www.gfscareers.us
 
 
🌐 About GFS
 
 
📹 Watch Us in Action
 
 
🔗 Connect on LinkedIn
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
**GFS is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants**
. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Employment offers are subject to successful completion of pre-employment drug screening and physicals, consistent with applicable laws.
 
 
Note to recruiters: GFS only works with agencies that have signed a contract with our HR team. Resumes sent directly to hiring managers without a prior agreement are considered unsolicited and the property of GFS. Placement fees will not be paid without a formal contract.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.
 
 
Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.
 
 
**What You’ll Do As a Director Quality**

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:

+ Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
+ Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
+ Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
+ Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
+ Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
+ Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
+ Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
+ Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.

* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
* Works closely with the regulatory function to ensure compliance to appropriate ISO and FDA standards; plans for and assists in the management of external audits.
* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.
* This individual has autonomy to perform the duties of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) on behalf of STERIS legal manufacturing entities under the EU MDR. This individual shall suffer no disadvantage within the organization in relation to proper fulfilment of his or her duties in lieu of article 15 of the EU MDR.

**Required**
**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or related technical field)
* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.
* Strong expertise in analytical methods, quality systems, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent interpersonal, as well as verbal and written communication skills in order to develop and maintain rapport and effective internal and external relationships to support business success.
* The ability to work hard and deliver results under pressure, as well as the willingness to address and shift priorities in rapidly changing markets.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree.
* Experience with statistical analysis software and Visio.
* Experience in medical device industry.

**Other**

* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Focus on identification of potential issues and continuous improvement.
* Experience working on cross-functional teams and on own initiative.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational, oral, and written communications skills.
* Must have PC experience, as well as working familiarity of desktop applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What STERIS Offers**
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial future.
 
 
**Here Is a Brief Overview Of What We Offer**

* Market competitive pay
* Extensive paid time off and (9) added holidays
* Excellent healthcare, dental, and vision benefits
* Long/short term disability coverage
* 401(K) with company match
* Maternity and parental leave
* Additional add on benefits/discounts for programs such as pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and continued educational programs
* Excellent opportunities for advancement in a stable long-term career

Pay range for this opportunity is $144,500.00 - $187,000.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.
 
 
Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.
