new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations Program Manager
new_roles.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.
 
 
Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.
 
 
As a Senior Manager, Operations Program Manager, you will lead a team responsible for driving hardware programs across the full product lifecycle — from New Product Introduction (NPI) through sustaining and high-volume mass production. This pivotal leadership role demands a seasoned expert capable of mentoring a high-performing team of Operations Program Managers, architecting capacity and ramp plans, and managing executive-level relationships with global Contract Manufacturers to optimize yield, quality, throughput, and cost. With over a decade of experience in hardware operations and a deep mastery of the full product lifecycle, you will drive cross-functional alignment from early development through mass production, oversee multi-million dollar capital expenditures, and navigate complex supply chain risks. We are looking for a financially-savvy leader with exceptional executive presence who is ready to optimize global operations and shape the future of our manufacturing footprint.
 
 
This is a US Hybrid role (3 days per week) based in our San Francisco, California office.
 
 
**What You Will Do**

* Strategic Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of Operations Program Managers spanning NPI and Sustaining programs, bridging product innovation and global manufacturing excellence across the full lifecycle.
* Program Delivery: Drive supply chain readiness for new product launches and sustaining programs, ensuring delivery on schedule, scale, cost, and quality from EVT through high-volume mass production. Owning programs end to end.
* Global Factory Operations: Oversee on-the-ground factory operations and own executive-level relationships with Contract Manufacturers (CMs), ensuring KPIs for yield, quality, and throughput are consistently met or exceeded across all programs.
* NPI Execution: Lead NPI program execution from concept through PRQ, partnering with Engineering and Product Management on supplier down-selections, launch strategy, and ramp planning.
* Sustaining & Lifecycle Strategy: Lead the Post Ramp Qualification (PRQ) framework, making high-stakes decisions on product changes necessitated by material shortages, quality improvements, or cost-reduction initiatives.
* Business Planning & Demand: Partner with Executive Leadership (Planning, Sourcing, Retail, Product, and Finance) to ensure global supply matches demand, owning the mitigation strategy for any supply chain disruptions.
* Infrastructure & Capacity: Architect the long-term capacity plan, including the strategic deployment of multi-million dollar capital expenditures for equipment, fixtures, and factory expansion across NPI and mass production.
* Risk & Material Management: Partner with MPMs on Materials Management strategy, proactively identifying systemic supply chain risks and implementing hedging or dual-sourcing strategies.
* Budgetary Oversight: Own the operational budget for NPI and Sustaining programs, including accountability for Opex, Capex, and variance reporting.

**We would love to have you on our team if you have:**

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in Hardware Operations, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Leadership across both NPI and sustaining/mass production phases, with at least 3 years in a formal people management role.
* Proven Leadership: A track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing teams in complex, fast-paced hardware environments, leading teams for 3+ years.
* Full Lifecycle Mastery: Deep expertise leading programs across all stages of the product lifecycle — from EVT and DVT through PVT, MP ramp, and sustaining — and across all Hardware disciplines (EE, ME, ID) and Supply Chain functions (Sourcing, Quality, Logistics, and Global Planning).
* Factory-Floor Expertise: Significant experience working directly on-site at international manufacturing facilities (JDM/ODM models), with a deep understanding of assembly lines, test stations, and factory floor dynamics.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex operational challenges into clear, actionable insights for C-suite executives.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing large-scale budgets and a sophisticated understanding of the financial drivers behind manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Self-Driven Excellence: A relentless drive to optimize processes and a passion for mentoring the next generation of hardware leaders.
* Global Mobility: Ability to travel internationally and domestically (up to 30%) to interface with partners and oversee factory builds.

**Benefits**
At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own, and we are continually looking to improve employee health.
 
 
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
* 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
* Paid sick leave and parental leave

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.
 
 
**San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550-$203,000**
ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
 
 
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
 
 
Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
 
 
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:
 
 

* Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.
* We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.
* Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.
 
 
To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

new_roles.title: Continuous Improvement Director
new_roles.description:
Have you ever u sed the self-checkout? Played the slots at a Casino? Maybe you grabbed a drink from a vending machine or paid to park your car? If you’ve answered with a resounding “YES”, then you’ve done so with the aid of one of the 10 million devices installed by Crane Payment Innovations (CPI).
 
 
We make the technology that powers your everyday life, enabling more than 4 billion transactions every week in more than 143 currencies worldwide. From cash and coins to cards and mobile, we keep the world of payments moving with smart validation devices and business management software.
 
 
Headquartered in Malvern, PA, CPI is supported by: ~2,000 global associates, 6 manufacturing sites, more than 10 corporate offices and a global field service organization.
 
 
**What You’ll Be Doing**
We are seeking a strategic and influential CBS Director for the Service Business Unit to build and facilitate the business system that turns strategy into execution. This role owns how we execute and improve as a business. The Director will lead strategy deployment and the transformation review cadence, develop repeatable growth and operating processes, and use daily management and kaizen to improve cross-functional performance. You will build and facilitate the Service business system that connects strategy, growth, customer experience, service capabilities, and operational execution. Working through functional leaders and initiative owners, you will make priorities, progress, barriers, and improvement opportunities visible while preserving clear accountability for business results and execution.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service business system: Design, implement, and continuously improve the management system used to translate Service Business Unit strategy into coordinated execution across functions.
* Strategy deployment: Facilitate the process for converting strategic priorities into defined initiatives, outcomes, measures, milestones, owners, and review routines.
* Transformation review cadence: Lead a consistent transformation review process that makes progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected benefits visible to business leadership.
* Accountability model: Maintain clear governance, templates, and escalation paths while preserving accountability with initiative owners for delivering and reporting their results.
* Growth processes: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Service leadership to develop a repeatable growth system spanning market mapping, target account selection, lead generation, account planning, opportunity qualification, funnel management, initiative launch, cross-functional readiness, benefit tracking, and revenue launch and ramp performance.
* Growth performance management: Establish practical measures and review routines that help leaders identify and address gaps in pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle time, launch performance, and progress against growth commitments.
* Operating processes: Standardize critical cross-functional processes where consistency, ownership, handoffs, or decision speed constrain execution.
* Daily management: Establish practical daily management routines, visual controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms that enable teams to identify and resolve issues at the appropriate level.
* Kaizen and continuous improvement: Identify, scope, facilitate, and sustain kaizen activity focused on meaningful cross-functional business priorities, using appropriate CBS tools and disciplined follow-through.
* Cross-functional performance: Partner across Operations, Commercial, Customer Experience, Quality, Technical Enablement, Service Offerings, Finance, HR, and other functions to improve end-to-end outcomes rather than isolated departmental measures.
* Problem solving and process improvement: Coach teams in structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, process mapping, standard work, action planning, and benefit validation.
* Performance visibility: Develop an integrated view of initiative progress, operating performance, growth metrics, risks, benefits, and corrective actions for leadership review.
* Capability building: Build business-system capability by coaching leaders and initiative owners, facilitating working sessions, and embedding repeatable methods rather than assuming ownership of their deliverables.
* Sustainment: Confirm that improvements are adopted, measured, and sustained through standard work, ownership, governance, and follow-up reviews.
* Enterprise learning: Document effective practices, scale them across the Service business, and share proven approaches more broadly within CPI where appropriate.
* Executive communication: Provide concise, fact-based updates on transformation progress, cross-functional performance, barriers, decisions required and realized benefits.

**Qualifications And Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience in continuous improvement, business transformation, strategy deployment, operational excellence, or business-system development.
* Demonstrated experience building or advancing an operating or business system that connects strategic priorities to execution and measurable results.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with commercial leaders on funnel management, account planning, opportunity qualification, or another measurable growth process.
* Strong working knowledge of lean management methods, including kaizen, daily management, visual management, value-stream or process mapping, standard work, and structured problem solving.
* Experience facilitating complex, cross-functional initiatives while maintaining clear accountability with business and initiative owners.
* Ability to design governance, review cadences, performance measures, and escalation routines that improve execution without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Excellent analytical, planning, facilitation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with frontline teams, functional leaders, and executives.
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to establish credibility, challenge constructively, and move groups toward decisions and deliverables in a matrixed environment.
* Experience in a service-intensive, field-service, industrial technology, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or comparable advanced continuous-improvement certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to support Service operations, transformation activity, and kaizen events as business needs require.

**Personal Attributes**

* Enterprise thinker: Connects strategy, growth, customer experience, capabilities, operating performance, and financial outcomes.
* System builder: Creates simple, repeatable management processes that clarify priorities, ownership, measures, and decisions.
* Facilitative leader: Enables leaders and initiative owners to execute successfully without taking accountability away from them.
* Results oriented: Focuses improvement activity on measurable business outcomes and sustained benefits.
* Objective and analytical: Uses facts, process evidence, and performance data to identify constraints and guide decisions.
* Constructive challenger: Surfaces gaps, risks, and trade-offs directly while maintaining trust and productive relationships.
* Change leader: Builds understanding, engagement, and adoption across functions and levels of the organization.
* Disciplined communicator: Makes progress, barriers, decisions, and accountability visible through concise and consistent communication.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
Service has a consistent, measurable growth process from market opportunity through qualified pipeline, launch, and revenue ramp. Leaders use a disciplined strategy and transformation review cadence to address gaps, resolve barriers, and make timely decisions. Improvements become part of how teams work, with clear measures, sustained standard work, and ownership that continues beyond each kaizen event or initiative launch.
 
 
**What We’re Offering**

* Base $190-210K
* Hybrid role
* Defined career growth plans with opportunities to go outside of your “comfort zone”
* Generous paid time off, including sick and holiday
* Medical, dental, & vision insurance
* 401K with Company contribution
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Discounts for childcare
* Tuition assistance
* Community involvement and volunteering events
* Opportunities to travel and work at our global sites

Sound interesting? Come see why we are !
 
 
**CPI is part of Crane NXT**
Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides proprietary and trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers. The company is a pioneer in advanced, proprietary micro-optics technology for securing physical products, and its sophisticated electronic equipment and associated software leverages proprietary core capabilities with detection and sensing technologies. Crane NXT has approximately 4,000 employees with global operations and manufacturing facilities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Japan, Switzerland, Germany, Sweden, and Malta. For more information, visit www.cranenxt.com.
 
 
*Crane Payment Innovations is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. Applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.*

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!
 
 
We currently have an opportunity for a
**Continuous Improvement Director**
at our
**Lake Forest Corporate Headquarters**
plant in
**Lake Forest, IL**
. This position will support our Malvern, AK, Louisville, KY, Bellwood, VA, and Wheeling plants with up to 75% travel. This position could also be located at our Malvern, AK, or Louisville, KY locations.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
The
**Continuous Improvement Director**
will be responsible for driving continuous improvement and demonstrating maximum efficiency and delivery productivity for the entire Business Unit (BU) with disciplined process and world class measures. The Continuous Improvement Director will be a key creator of the Continuous Improvement and Digital Factory strategy for the BU, leveraging best practices across our manufacturing sites as we continue to develop our Boundless operating system across Reynolds Consumer Products (RCP). We embrace and accept individual experiences and backgrounds to achieve a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 
 
**You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!**
**Strategy & Business Transformation**

* Develop plans, schedules, and budgets for tactical projects to improve existing processes; ensure cost-benefit evaluation for all assigned projects are completed to define potential financial, business and industry impacts of initiatives.
* Support the business leaders in the development of intermediate and long-term CI strategies to assure delivery of the projected CI Saving Budget.
* Create the digital manufacturing (IoT) strategy and coach plant teams on implementation and sustained performance enhancement as a result.
* Advise and influence senior leadership on business transformation topics that include organizational effectiveness, performance results, and change management in the terms of complexity and impact on the business.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Manage a CI Savings Budget across the Business Unit that represents an achievable value to deliver back to the business.
* Act as the subject matter expert for the core pillars of the Boundless operating system to assure sustained results, including assisting in training and plant acclimation to the new PEPS process.
* Drive the improvement of processes and systems in the plants and implement programs that will have continuing long-term benefits.
* Continuously evaluate and measure program or initiative performance and progress against goals and serve as a change agent within the organization.
* Monitor existing processes to make sure they continue to perform at optimal levels of efficiency achieving lowered conversion costs year-over-year.
* Direct all CI activities to include Kaizen events in 5S, SMED, TPM, VSM, PDCA or equivalent, A3 Problem Solving.
* Ensure adherence to Lean Methodology, including Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Daily Management, Layered Audit Process and Business Plan development to eliminate waste.
* Confer with management, engineering, and other staff regarding manufacturing capabilities, production schedules, and other considerations to facilitate production process improvements.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Effectively lead, manage, develop, coach, and evaluate team members and associates at various levels of experience.
* Develop and deliver Lean Training at all levels of the organization while driving Operational Excellence standards.

**You Will Love It Here If…**

* You listen, learn, and evolve
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment
* You put safety first, always
* You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
* You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
* You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

**Qualifications**
**Education/Experience**
**Required**

* BA/BS degree in Business, Supply Chain or related field.
* 10+ years of related professional Manufacturing with experience in Continuous Improvement and Operations.
* 3+ years in a leadership role focused on continuous improvement or operational excellence.

**Preferred**

* MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred.
* Previous experience with Automation and SAP strongly preferred.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient in MS Office with advanced Excel Skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills and the ability to communicate and influence at all levels within the organization.
* Self-directed with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple accountabilities and multiple internal customers.
* Strong analytical skills as well as organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Solid project management capabilities with the ability to organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously from origin through execution.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule during key business deadlines.
* Must be team oriented with the ability to work on high collaboration and performance teams.

**Competencies**

* Results Driven – Ability to focus on organizational growth, financial performance and achieving results.
* Critical Decision Maker – Clear, critical thinker that engages in thoughtful, data-driven decisions and has the ability to summarize and draw appropriate conclusions from complex data.
* Strategic Orientation – Ability to balance short-term goals with long-term organizational and functional strategic priorities.
* Innovative Thinking – A forward thinker who offers new, creative and often unconventional thoughts, opinions and methods for solution generation and problem solving.
* People Leadership – Ability to develop employees through coaching and feedback and holds team members accountable through modeling appropriate behavior.
* Compelling Communication – Effective written and verbal communicator that clearly and succinctly conveys information across all levels.

Want to know more? Check out our website or connect with us on LinkedIn!
 
 
**Apply today to join a fast-growing innovative company!**
Not a good fit but know someone who is? Please refer them!
 
 
**No unsolicited recruiter or agency inquiries, please.**
RCP affords equal employment opportunities to applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability status, sex, marital status, protected veteran status, pregnancy, national origin, genetics, genetic information, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. RCP conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.
 
 
**Posted Salary Range**
USD $144,100.00 - USD $214,350.00 /A
 
 
**Bonus Eligibility**
Role is eligible for 25% annual incentive provided the business meets financial goals and the individual meets their performance goals, subject to plan administration guidelines.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 
**Director, Operational Excellence**
We're advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. We're focused on helping more people take action against cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages, so they can live longer, healthier lives.
 
 
This role is based on-site in Madison, WI.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Abbott is seeking a Director, Operational Excellence to lead the development, implementation, and sustainability of operational excellence practices across our Cancer Diagnostics operations.
 
 
This leader will partner closely with operations leadership and frontline teams to strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and build a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead the implementation of operational excellence practices that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and sustain tiered management routines, visual performance boards, standardized metrics, and structured performance reviews across hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Partner with operations leaders to implement supervisor standard work, strengthen accountability, and develop consistent problem-solving and performance management practices.
* Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve process flow, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and drive measurable operational results.
* Establish employee-driven improvement programs that encourage frontline participation, idea generation, and ownership of operational improvements.
* Lead change management efforts that ensure new processes are adopted, embedded into daily operations, and sustained over time.
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to align improvement initiatives with business priorities.
* Lead and coach a team of operational excellence professionals while building continuous improvement capabilities across the broader organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant progressive experience in operations leadership, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a manufacturing, laboratory, or complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining Lean practices, daily management systems, visual performance management, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience leading operational teams or working directly with frontline leaders to drive measurable performance improvements.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build accountability.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct leadership experience in manufacturing, laboratory, or other high-volume operations.
* Experience in regulated industries such as diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience implementing tiered management systems, supervisor standard work, and employee-driven continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated success sustaining operational improvements through frontline engagement and leadership ownership.

The base pay for this position is $149,300.00 – $298,700.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

new_roles.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Description**
****Position Summary****
The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister’s enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister’s CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.
 
 
The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.
 
 
The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.
 
 
****Position Duties/Responsibilities****
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister’s CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures—leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time—with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister’s Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister’s enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

****Position Requirements****
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver’s license.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

****Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities****

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

****Other Requirements of Position****

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.
 
 
All MacAllister Machinery companies are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including Disabled and Veteran applicants.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality-Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Us:**
BW Papersystems, part of the Barry-Wehmiller Group, builds capital equipment that transforms paper into products for consumers - every day, around the world. We offer innovative technologies, service and parts, and years of global experience in corrugating, finishing; slitting and packaging; stationery; bookbinding and security documents. Customers rely on our machines to produce and convert items such as corrugated boxes, folding cartons, passports, notebooks, copy paper, board, and coated and other specialty papers. For more information, visit bwpapersystems.com.
 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
 
 
**Job Description:**
The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy. In this critical role, the Director of Quality will be the leader in developing and maintaining a quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction, and to increase profitability in a safe working environment.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the management team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy.
* Develop and maintain a business/quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction and increase profitability in a safe working environment within the local business.
* Continuously assess the overall Quality Management System, Quality Plan and Quality Organization to determine priorities for quality improvement.
* Establish the key improvement priorities, and using a strategy deployment approach, develop and execute a cross-functional, strategic action plan to drive improvement.
* Identify the leading sources of customer dissatisfaction.
* Determine the underlying causes and develop/execute strategies to eliminate those causes.
* Determine the true, systemic root causes of internal failure and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Execute a strategy consisting of well-planned and executed preventive actions that reduce COPQ and other forms of waste.
* Drive improvements in process quality, production efficiency, and the elimination of the factors that drive variability and unforeseen disruptions.
* Drive a strategy that incorporates standard work, effective training, and recurring process audits to ensure process discipline.
* Establish and maintain appropriate KPIs that provide objective evidence of improvement
* Participate in training and coaching teams in the standard quality improvement approach and quality management standard requirements to develop organizational capability.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, quality, continuous improvement, or related field.
* 10+ years of professional experience leading a Quality Organization in capital equipment manufacturing environment.
* Experience with the execution of continuous improvement methodology such as Operational Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Strategy Deployment, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

* Requires the ability to independently resolve complex problems.
* Requires ability to manage a skilled and diverse staff, communicate effectively, represent the organization, act decisively, and influence decisions of senior managers and customers.
* Requires foresight to anticipate problems and recognize opportunities for cost-effectively improving operations.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
* Decision Quality – Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

*The approximate pay range for this position is $155,000 to $210,000 base salary. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.*
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.
 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.

BW Papersystems

new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences.
 
 
The Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for advancing quality engineering practices across a defined portion of Humana’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Quality Engineering – Segment, this role will lead teams responsible for delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement across multiple product and application teams.
 
 
This leader will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality partners to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability.

**Responsibilities**

 

* Lead quality engineering strategy and execution across a defined portfolio, domain, or segment.
* Lead and develop quality engineering managers, leads, engineers, and SDETs; drive organization design, talent growth, and team performance.
* Establish portfolio quality goals, KPIs, and governance to improve delivery quality, release readiness, and production stability.
* Embed built-in quality across planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Oversee test strategy and execution across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and release validation.
* Own portfolio-level quality risk management, including defect trends, release concerns, environment issues, and cross-team dependencies.
* Drive automation-first practices and integrate quality signals, validation, and gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities and promote innovative practices that improve speed, coverage, and reliability.
* Sponsor modernization of quality frameworks, tooling, and test approaches for APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Oversee non-functional quality practices, including performance, resiliency, operational readiness, and security validation.
* Use metrics and production insights to drive continuous improvement, maturity, and investment priorities.
* Partner with segment and enterprise stakeholders to align execution with broader quality engineering strategy, standards, and reference architecture direction.
* Ensure responsible adoption of AI and compliance with applicable security, privacy, regulatory, and operational standards.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, testing, or related technical disciplines.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing quality engineering, test automation, or software delivery teams in large enterprise environments.
* Experience leading quality engineering execution across multiple agile teams or a complex application/product portfolio.
* Demonstrated success driving quality engineering modernization, including automation, tooling, process improvement, and metrics-driven execution.
* Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing approaches.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and modern application architectures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
* Experience working in matrixed organizations and leading geographically distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Familiarity with member, provider, digital experience, or enterprise platform domains.
* Experience with enterprise quality tools, test management platforms, and engineering lifecycle tools.
* Knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience supporting non-functional testing, including performance and resiliency.
* Exposure to AI-enabled quality engineering or intelligent automation capabilities.
* Familiarity with enterprise reference architecture principles, patterns, and standards in cloud, hybrid, on-premise, and SaaS environments.

**Success in this Role**

 

* In this role, success will be measured by:
* Improved release stability and delivery quality across the assigned portfolio.
* Reduced escaped defects and production incidents related to delivery quality.
* Increased automation adoption, regression reliability, and validation efficiency.
* Stronger integration of quality engineering into engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Advancement of quality engineering maturity and consistent execution across teams.
* Positive stakeholder partnership and strong team engagement and development outcomes.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. 
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. 
$156,600 - $215,400 per year 
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading the organization's Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI), risk management, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement programs. This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure the delivery of safe, high-quality, patient-centered care while maintaining compliance with federal, state, and accreditation standards.

The Director collaborates with medical staff, nursing leadership, department directors, and executive leadership to develop a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory readiness, patient safety, and organizational excellence. This role serves as a key resource for performance improvement initiatives, risk reduction strategies, accreditation activities, and quality outcomes reporting.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Quality and Performance Improvement**

* Lead and oversee the hospital's Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) Program.
* Collect, analyze, interpret, and report quality, patient safety, and performance improvement data.
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality indicators, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics.
* Facilitate performance improvement projects utilizing evidence-based methodologies and best practices.
* Coordinate organization-wide quality improvement initiatives to improve clinical outcomes, patient experience, and operational effectiveness.
* Prepare and present quality reports to leadership, medical staff committees, quality committees, and the Governing Board.
* Conduct audits, chart reviews, tracers, and compliance assessments to identify opportunities for improvement.

**Risk Management and Patient Safety**

* Direct the organization's risk management and patient safety programs.
* Investigate adverse events, patient complaints, grievances, safety events, near misses, and claims.
* Perform root cause analyses (RCA), failure mode and effects analyses (FMEA), and corrective action planning.
* Identify organizational risks and implement strategies to reduce patient, staff, and visitor harm.
* Monitor trends and implement proactive risk reduction initiatives.
* Collaborate with leadership to develop and monitor corrective action plans and ensure sustained improvements.

**Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation**

* Ensure compliance with CMS Conditions of Participation, Critical Access Hospital regulations, Texas Department of State Health Services requirements, and other applicable federal and state regulations.
* Coordinate survey readiness activities and accreditation preparation.
* Develop, review, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and compliance programs.
* Coordinate responses to regulatory agencies and external surveyors.
* Monitor regulatory changes and communicate requirements throughout the organization.

**Utilization Review and Resource Management**

* Coordinate activities associated with utilization review and clinical resource management.
* Monitor appropriate utilization of healthcare resources and patient care services.
* Evaluate admission, continued stay, and discharge practices for regulatory and quality compliance.
* Analyze utilization data and recommend improvements in resource management and care coordination.
* Collaborate with managed care organizations, payers, and review organizations as appropriate.

**Leadership and Staff Development**

* Supervise and mentor quality analytics personnel.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Provide education and consultation to leaders, providers, and staff regarding quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.
* Promote interdisciplinary collaboration to improve organizational performance and patient outcomes.

**Data Analysis and Reporting**

* Compile, analyze, and interpret statistical and clinical performance data.
* Prepare executive summaries, reports, presentations, and regulatory submissions.
* Monitor and report outcomes related to patient safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, risk management, and compliance initiatives.
* Utilize data to drive decision-making and performance improvement efforts.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Participate in strategic planning and organizational initiatives.
* Support medical staff quality activities and credentialing-related quality reviews.
* Serve on organizational committees as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Current, unrestricted Texas Registered Nurse (RN) license.
* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Quality Management, or a related healthcare field.
* Current CPR certification.
* Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare quality, performance improvement, risk management, regulatory compliance, or related healthcare leadership functions.
* Knowledge of CMS Conditions of Participation, Critical Access Hospital regulations, quality measurement methodologies, and healthcare performance improvement principles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, leadership, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, leadership, regulatory agencies, and interdisciplinary teams.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or related field.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ).
* Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) or related certification.
* Experience with QIPP, RAPPS, NHSN, CMS quality reporting programs, and accreditation surveys.
* Experience leading successful regulatory, accreditation, or state survey activities.
* Experience with medical staff bylaws, peer review, credentialing quality processes, and performance improvement programs.

new_roles.description:
Granite State Manufacturing is a leading contract manufacturer of large, complex, precision machined and welded components, supporting the US Navy in building submarines.

We specialize in high-mix, low-to-medium volume production, delivering precision, quality, and on-time performance on custom-engineered products. Our capabilities include:

* Large-format CNC machining
* Heavy fabrication and welding (MIG, TIG, FCAW, SAW)
* Assembly, inspection, and testing
* Program management for complex builds

We are known for handling tight tolerances, complex geometries, and demanding customer specifications.

Our work environment is supportive, providing what our people need to do great work.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Plans, coordinates, and directs quality program designed to ensure continuous production of products consistent with established standards. Continuously increasing Quality Awareness across the company, with the goal of reducing and eliminating barriers and obstacles to throughput, while reducing overall cost and schedule. Leadership, both within the QC/QA staff, and across all departments, is expected to make it easier for employees to make quality products, and make it easier for customers to do business with GSM.

We strive to make things faster, better, and less expensively.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* You will be the face of Quality to our customers, and will participate in program reviews with GSM and Customer senior management.
* Leading our Continuous Improvement efforts will provide you with the ability to make substantial changes to our internal processes and procedures across the board, in our constant efforts to be more efficient, more effective, and more valuable to our customers.
* Directs workers engaged in inspection and testing activities to ensure continuous control over materials, facilities, and products.
* In addition to the Quality Engineers and Quality Assurance Specialists, your direct reports will include the Quality Inspectors and Quality Administrators. Working closely together with your team you will make great use of complementary skills and experience, and be most effective in bringing GSM‘s performance to the next
* Plans, promotes, and organizes training activities related to product quality and reliability.

* Build a path with continuous improvement efforts to be more efficient, more effective, and more valuable to customers. Strive to increase production speed, improve quality, and reduce
* Participates in evaluation of Vendor Quality.
* Demonstrates responsibility and accountability for creating a professional, safe, and clean environment evidenced by: being at work on time to perform assigned duties, following the policies of Granite State Manufacturing, always wearing safety glasses in designated areas, maintaining a neat and orderly work area, and following safety practices to prevent errors.
* Demonstrates commitment to teamwork by establishing effective relationships and networks with both managers/directors and workers, and collaborating with them to accomplish shared purposes and goals.
* Abides by GSM Code of Ethics and Business Conduct standards and strictly observes all U.S. and foreign laws and regulations.

**EEO STATEMENT**

Granite State Manufacturing (GSM) is an equal opportunity employer. GSM does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship, veteran status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws in its programs, activities, or employment.

 **Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* **Bachelor's degree and related experience and /or training or equivalent combination of education and experience.**

* **Ability to write technical reports, ISO procedures and correspondence.**
* **Ability to deal with difficult problems involving ambiguous circumstances in non-standardized situations.**

**Director of Quality Assurance** 
Location: 203A Log Canoe Circle, Stevensville, MD 21666 
Shift Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday 
Pay Range: $135,000 -175,000 + Bonus Eligibility!

**Hydrasearch,** a proud affiliate of The Dixon Group, is looking for a **Director of Quality Assurance** to join our team in **Stevensville, MD**! The Director of Quality Assurance will lead the organization's quality management strategy and ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. This role is responsible for overseeing quality assurance programs, driving continuous improvement initiatives, managing quality personnel, and partnering with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to maintain high standards of product quality and operational excellence.

**At Hydrasearch, we value the contributions of our Military Veterans and proudly employ our nation’s heroes. Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance function across the organization.
* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with AS9100D and ISO 9001, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Establish quality objectives, metrics, and reporting processes to drive continuous improvement.
* Oversee internal audits, external audits, and customer quality assessments.
* Manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs and root cause analysis initiatives.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership to improve product and process quality.
* Analyze quality data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint investigations and resolution efforts.
* Develop and drive supplier quality programs. Actively work with vendors to address quality concerns.
* Build, mentor, and develop quality personnel and future leaders within the organization.
* Support new product introduction activities by ensuring quality standards are incorporated into design and manufacturing processes.
* Prepare and present quality performance updates to executive leadership.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field required; Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within manufacturing, maritime & aerospace defense, industrial, or related industries required; experience supporting defense, military, or government-contract manufacturing environments preferred.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality teams and managing direct reports.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100D & ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Demonstrated success implementing continuous improvement programs and driving measurable results.
* Experience with root cause analysis methodologies and corrective action processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control methodologies is a plus!
* This hands-on leadership position requires extensive maritime and aerospace defense quality experience, strong knowledge of industry standards and regulations, and proven success managing external audits and compliance initiatives.

**What We Offer:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
* Competitive salary
* Bonus programs
* 401K retirement plan
* Training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement
* Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
* Gym reimbursements, and more!

new_roles.title: Director, AI Quality, Evaluation & Observability Engineering
new_roles.description:
### **Why Patients Need You**

Pfizer's Commercial organization is putting GenAI and AI agents into work that shapes how medicines reach patients, from content creation and review to field and customer engagement. If we can't show that these systems are accurate, safe and behaving as intended, they don't belong in production. You will build the engineering capability that lets Pfizer prove it, before release and every day after.

### **What You Will Achieve**

You will own the evaluation and observability capability for AI solutions across the Commercial portfolio, and you will be accountable for the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards: the metrics, thresholds and technical criteria that inform production-readiness and ongoing monitoring decisions. You will build shared tooling, datasets and metrics that let product teams measure quality, safety and performance consistently, catch regressions before release, and detect drift and failures in production. You will set your team's priorities and decide where its engineering capacity goes across the portfolio. Success means teams evaluate through your platform by default, release decisions rest on evidence, and production AI issues are caught by monitoring before users or auditors find them.

### **How You Will Achieve It**

* Build and run a shared evaluation platform for GenAI and agentic solutions. It covers offline test suites, regression testing in CI/CD, LLM-as-judge and rubric-based scoring, and structured human review workflows.
* Set the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards, including metrics for accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, safety, bias, robustness and task success and the minimum monitoring every production AI solution must have. Calibrate automated scoring against expert human judgment and publish the agreement rates.
* Partner with commercial technology leaders to create and govern golden datasets and test sets with domain experts (e.g., medical, legal and regulatory reviewers), including versioning, data lineage and handling of sensitive data.
* Implement production observability for AI systems, including tracing of prompts, retrievals, tool calls and agent steps, plus monitoring of quality, drift, latency, cost and guardrail activity, with alerting and incident response.
* Evaluate technical and model quality, with business outcomes and value measured separately.
* Set the evaluation thresholds and technical production-readiness criteria that feed release gates run by SDLC Standards & Governance, and give a clear pass, conditional or fail assessment against them, so go-live decisions rely on measured results rather than demos.
* Partner with Responsible AI, Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity and Compliance to turn policy requirements into measurable tests and auditable evidence, including support for AI-related audits and regulatory inquiries.
* Run adversarial and red-team testing (e.g., prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage) with Cybersecurity, and feed the findings back into evaluation suites.
* Evaluate models and vendors objectively when teams select or upgrade foundation models, AI platforms or third-party AI products in partnership with Strategic Partnerships and contracting, so vendor decisions stay joined up.
* Report quality and reliability trends across the AI portfolio to senior Digital and Commercial leadership.
* Set priorities for the AI quality and observability team and allocate its engineering capacity against portfolio needs, based on risk, release timing and business impact. Make the trade-offs visible and escalate when demand exceeds capacity.
* Lead and develop a team of AI quality and observability engineers that will evolve over time, and coach product and vendor teams, including third-party and offshore partners, to own their evaluations using shared tooling.

### **Decision Rights & Escalation**

* **Decides:** Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards, metrics, thresholds and minimum monitoring requirements; the technical readiness assessment for each release; team priorities and capacity allocation; evaluation tooling and platform design within enterprise architecture standards.
* **Informs:** Release go/no-go decisions made through SDLC stage gates and product ownership; model, platform and vendor selection decisions led with Strategic Partnerships and contracting.
* **Escalates to the Commercial AI Portfolio Lead when:** a team wants to release a solution that does not meet agreed thresholds (risk acceptance); a production issue creates patient-safety, compliance or reputational exposure; demand for evaluation support exceeds team capacity across priority programs; or Responsible AI, Legal or Cybersecurity cannot agree on how a requirement becomes a test.

### **Qualifications**

**Must-Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in software, ML or data engineering, including 3+ years building evaluation, testing or monitoring for ML or GenAI systems in production.
* Hands-on experience designing LLM evaluations, including rubric and LLM-as-judge methods, human evaluation design, and statistically sound comparison of model or prompt versions.
* Experience instrumenting production systems for observability (tracing, metrics, logging, alerting) and running incident response.
* Strong Python skills and experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leading engineering teams and influencing product teams across a matrix without direct authority.
* Ability to explain evaluation results and their limits plainly to non-technical leaders.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Arize, Weights & Biases, MLflow, Ragas, Promptfoo).
* Experience evaluating RAG systems and multi-step AI agents, including tool use and MCP-based integrations.
* Familiarity with AI risk and regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001).
* Experience with AI red-teaming or adversarial testing.
* Pharmaceutical or life sciences experience, ideally with Commercial, promotional review, medical or other regulated content.

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality (Head of Quality)
new_roles.description:
Division Department: Therapeutics | Quality

Position Title: Director of Quality (Head of Quality)

Reports To: Corporate Head of Quality (proposed; final reporting structure to be confirmed)

Salary - $225-250,000 based on experience

**PharmaLogic is expanding our therapeutics business line. Our therapeutics business, Agilera, is the** **world’s only cGMP-compliant CDMO currently manufacturing and distributing commercial radiopharmaceutical therapeutics across more than 30 countries. In this role,** **you will have the opportunity to work as part of a unique environment that is involved in the entire value chain, from the preclinical phase to the commercial production and distribution of radiopharmaceuticals.**

**Role Summary:**

The Director of Quality serves as the Head of Quality for PharmaLogic’s newly acquired therapeutics business, leading the quality organization and establishing the systems, capabilities, and culture needed for reliable GMP manufacturing. This leader is accountable for the pharmaceutical quality system and Quality oversight of sterile therapeutic drug manufacturing, testing, and release under applicable 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 requirements. As a member of the site leadership team, the Director partners with Operations, Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and corporate Quality to support clinical supply, technology transfer, commercialization, and growth. The role requires independent judgment, visible leadership on the manufacturing floor, and the ability to translate quality requirements into practical execution while protecting patient safety and product quality.

**Job Responsibilities and Duties:**

**Quality Leadership and Governance**

Lead the Quality function, including Quality Assurance and oversight of Quality Control and microbiology activities within the assigned organizational scope. Set strategy, staffing, budgets, objectives, and development plans; build a capable team with clear accountability.

Maintain the Quality unit’s independent authority to approve or reject materials and drug products, including outsourced products; approve quality-impacting procedures and specifications; and ensure documented responsibilities and appropriate escalation to corporate Quality and executive leadership.

Own batch disposition through authorized Quality personnel. Ensure production and laboratory records, deviations, and required test results receive appropriate review before release. Place materials or product on hold and stop affected operations when quality or compliance concerns warrant.

**Quality Systems and Sterile Manufacturing**

Establish and continuously improve systems for deviations, investigations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, document control, training, complaints, product quality reviews, and quality risk management. Require scientifically sound root-cause analysis and verification of CAPA effectiveness.

Provide Quality oversight of aseptic processing and contamination control, including cleanrooms, environmental and personnel monitoring, gowning qualification, aseptic process simulations, sterilization, disinfection, and container closure integrity, as applicable.

Oversee laboratory controls, specifications, analytical method validation and transfer, stability programs, and investigations of out-of-specification and out-of-trend results. Ensure complete, accurate, traceable data and effective controls for electronic records and computerized systems.

Approve qualification and validation strategies, protocols, and reports for facilities, utilities, equipment, manufacturing processes, cleaning, and computerized systems. Ensure a documented lifecycle approach and continued process verification.

**Manufacturing Readiness and External Partners**

Lead Quality readiness for new products, technology transfers, process scale-up, and commercial launches. Establish clear acceptance criteria and readiness decisions with Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs.

Serve as the primary site Quality representative for FDA inspections and customer audits. Lead inspection preparation, responses, and commitments; maintain sustained readiness and timely, effective remediation.

Manage supplier qualification, contract laboratory and manufacturer oversight, audits, and quality agreements. Define responsibilities with CDMO customers and ensure outsourced activities meet agreed quality requirements.

**Acquisition Integration and Regulatory Partnership**

Lead the acquisition Quality integration plan: assess inherited systems and commitments, prioritize gaps by risk, align governance and procedures with corporate standards, and manage changes without disrupting compliant product supply.

Partner with Regulatory Affairs on manufacturing and quality content for filings, change assessments, and regulatory commitments. Lead quality defect assessments and support recalls, field actions, and required notifications with designated functions.

For radiopharmaceutical therapeutics, oversee appropriate controls for isotope and precursor quality, radiochemical testing, time-sensitive manufacturing and disposition, and stability. Partner with Radiation Safety and EHS on safe, compliant execution.

**Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement**

Present quality performance and material risks to site and corporate leadership. Use management reviews and meaningful metrics to improve investigation quality, CAPA effectiveness, release reliability, training, and inspection readiness.

**Job Requirements, Skills and Education:**

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, microbiology, pharmacy, engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

Typically, 10 or more years of progressive pharmaceutical Quality experience, including at least 5 years leading teams or major Quality programs in a GMP manufacturing environment.

Demonstrated Quality leadership in sterile injectable manufacturing, with substantial knowledge of aseptic processing, contamination control, laboratory controls, validation, and data integrity.

**Strong working knowledge of 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, applicable electronic records requirements, and relevant FDA guidance and ICH quality principles.**

Experience leading regulatory inspections, complex investigations, remediation, and batch disposition, with sound scientific judgment and the ability to defend quality decisions.

Experience supporting technology transfer, clinical or commercial manufacturing, and cross-functional delivery of significant quality or operational improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals or radioligand therapies; CDMO operations and pharmaceutical customer partnerships; and commercial launch or preapproval inspection readiness.

Experience integrating an acquisition, building or transforming a quality organization, and implementing electronic quality management systems. Advanced scientific degree or relevant professional certification.

**Leadership and Working Expectations**

A visible, hands-on leader who develops people, communicates clearly, and holds teams accountable. Able to challenge decisions constructively, escalate risks promptly, and make timely decisions under pressure. Regular onsite presence in manufacturing and laboratory areas, compliance with required gowning and safety practices, and availability for critical quality events are expected. Travel requirements will be defined for the role. Essential functions may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

Come join our winning team and begin a fulfilling career with us by applying today. 
 
PharmaLogic is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other protected class.

**Benefits Include:**

401(k) retirement benefit program

Medical

Dental care

Disability insurance

Employee assistance program

Life insurance

On-site parking

Paid time off

Vision care
