new_roles.title: Senior Director, GMP Quality Assurance (Commercial)
new_roles.description:
At Kailera, we are bold, authentic and committed to our mission of developing therapies that give people the power to transform their lives and elevate their overall health. Rooted in an entrepreneurial spirit and a team-oriented culture, we are working together to advance Kailera's mission to advance novel therapies for obesity and related conditions.
 
 
We are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes collaboration, integrity, and excellence. As we expand, we seek the most talented individuals with diverse backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and experiences to join our team.

**What You'll Do:**

Kailera is preparing to bring its therapies to patients, and the Senior Director, GMP Quality Assurance will lead the quality strategy that gets us there. Reporting to the Head of Quality Assurance, you will be accountable for GMP Quality across drug substance, drug product, packaging/labeling, testing, stability, and product release as Kailera moves from late-stage clinical supply to commercial manufacturing and launch. You will develop and execute the commercial GMP Quality strategy, build the quality systems and team needed for a compliant and reliable commercial supply chain, and serve as a trusted quality leader with Technical Operations, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and our network of contract manufacturers and testing laboratories.

 

*Required location: Waltham, MA (hub-based, onsite 3-4 days per week) OR Remote (home-based, onsite at a hub 1 week every other month).*

 

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute the commercial GMP Quality strategy and roadmap, aligned with company and functional objectives, to support registration, launch, and lifecycle supply of Kailera products
* Be accountable for the performance and results of the GMP Quality function, including key quality initiatives, goals, and product assets
* Evolve the Kailera Quality Management System from clinical phase to commercial readiness, including change control, deviations/CAPA, complaints, product quality reviews, supplier management, training, and data integrity
* Define GMP quality metrics and KPIs for Quality Management Review, and use trends to anticipate risks and drive continuous improvement across the manufacturing network
* Advise senior leadership on quality risks, compliance trade-offs, and changes in the global regulatory environment, translating external trends into Kailera's quality strategy
* Lead the quality aspects of commercial readiness, including oversight of process performance qualification (PPQ), process and analytical method validation, commercial specifications, and stability programs
* Lead pre-approval and pre-license inspection (PAI/PLI) readiness across Kailera and contract manufacturing sites; host or support health authority inspections and drive timely, effective responses and commitments
* Partner with Regulatory CMC to ensure commercial manufacturing and controls are consistent with marketing applications; provide QA review of CMC sections of regulatory filings, post-approval supplements, and variations
* Establish and oversee commercial batch record review and lot disposition, ensuring final disposition complies with approved registrations and supporting QP certification for EU supply
* Build post-market quality processes, including product complaint handling, regulatory reporting (e.g., Field Alert Reports), recalls, and annual product quality reviews.
* Oversee quality requirements for commercial packaging, labeling, artwork control, and serialization (DSCSA and other market requirements)
* Ensure Good Distribution Practice (GDP) compliance for commercial distribution, including qualification of third-party logistics providers, temperature excursion management, and returns
* Where applicable, integrate combination product and device quality requirements (e.g., 21 CFR Part 4) for drug-device presentations
* Develop and lead risk-based quality oversight of CDMOs, contract testing laboratories, and other GMP suppliers, including qualification, audits, and performance management.
* Negotiate and maintain commercial Quality Agreements and ensure adherence by Kailera and its partners
* Use independent judgment to resolve highly complex or novel quality issues, such as major deviations, OOS investigations, and supply disruptions, balancing patient safety, compliance, and supply continuity
* Direct cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams across Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and external partners to resolve quality events and implement improvements
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing GMP Quality team as Kailera scales to commercial operations, including organizational design, hiring, and succession planning
* Drive followership by leading with trust, understanding, and adaptability; coach managers and team members, recognize contributions, and foster a culture of quality, accountability, and psychological safety
* Manage GMP Quality budget and resources, including the use of external consultants and auditors

 

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of GMP experience in the FDA-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (or 10+ years with an advanced degree), including significant experience supporting commercial products
* Demonstrated success leading quality activities for product registration and commercial launch, including PPQ and PAI/PLI readiness
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, including building and developing teams
* Expert knowledge of cGMP and GDP requirements, including 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, and 11, EudraLex Volume 4 (including Annex 16), and ICH Q7, Q9, and Q10; working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 4 and DSCSA preferred
* Track record of successfully hosting or supporting FDA, EMA, and/or other health authority inspections
* Extensive experience leading quality oversight of CDMOs and contract laboratories, including audits and Quality Agreements
* Proficient in Veeva QualityDocs and Veeva QMS or a comparable electronic quality system
* Recognized expertise in GMP quality, with the judgment to give clear, risk-based quality advice that balances compliance with business needs
* Exceptional communication skills; tailors messages to executives, cross-functional partners, contract manufacturers, and health authorities, and explains the rationale behind decisions to build buy-in
* Proven ability to guide teams through complex change and ambiguity, anticipate problems before they escalate, and keep work focused on defined outcomes in a fast-paced, growing company
* Builds trusting relationships internally and externally, and navigates conflict through open dialogue and collaboration
* Brings creative, practical solutions to complex problems and encourages others to take calculated risks that challenge the status quo while maintaining compliance

 

**Education:**

* BA or BS degree in a scientific discipline required; advanced degree preferred

**For Full Time Roles:** This range represents the company's good-faith estimate of the salary at the time of posting. Actual pay may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and internal equity. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a year-end shutdown. Enjoy a monthly wellness stipend, generous 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement, commuter benefits, disability and life insurance, plus annual bonus opportunities and equity grants—because your well-being and future matter to us.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY INFORMATION:**

Kailera Therapeutics, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, creed, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age (40 and over), sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, domestic victim status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

*E-Verify:*

Kailera Therapeutics, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Mercantile Development, Inc. (MDI) is a leading independent converter of nonwoven wiping products, proudly family-owned and operated for over 75 years. As a WBENC-certified Women’s Business Enterprise, we are driven by a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer-focused service. Our Pro-Series® professional-grade wiping products are manufactured in our 140,000 sq. ft. state-of-the-art facility in Shelton, Connecticut under an ISO 9001:2015 certified Quality Management System and distributed worldwide across diverse industries.

At MDI, we value innovation, collaboration, accuracy, and integrity. We are proud to foster a workplace culture that encourages creative problem-solving, continuous improvement, and strong team relationships.

Mercantile Development is seeking a hands-on Operations Director to lead all aspects of site operations and oversee a small team. You will hold direct responsibility for the daily management of the facility, including production, warehousing, engineering, maintenance, and the grounds and infrastructure of the property. The role requires active involvement in every operational area to keep the site safe, efficient, well maintained, and profitable, while consistently meeting customer requirements, quality standards, production goals, and business objectives. This is a full-time, onsite position for a seasoned manufacturing leader who is comfortable running the daily operation and independently driving the projects, facility improvements, and initiatives that move the business forward.

**Job Responsibilities**

· Own the day-to-day running of the Shelton site, setting priorities and standards across every department and holding department leads accountable for safety, quality, delivery, and cost results.

· Coordinate scheduling and resource decisions among departments, working with the Production Supervisor to keep customer commitments and site capacity in balance.

· Establish and review site-wide KPIs, including equipment utilization, labor efficiency, downtime, waste, and inventory flow, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.

· Safeguard the site's physical assets, including production equipment, utilities, building systems, and rooftop solar installations, through preventive maintenance, inspections, and timely repairs.

· Develop the site's long-range facility and capital plan, then lead CAPEX projects from budgeting and vendor selection through startup and results validation.

· Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and safe manufacturing practices, and a passion for building a workplace where safety comes first.

· Manage vendor and contractor relationships, maintenance spending, and operating budgets to control costs and maximize value.

· Promote accountability, workforce development, and root-cause problem solving across the organization.

· Update executive leadership regularly on performance, risks, staffing, facility issues, and capital needs.

**Requirements**

· 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership, including accountability for output and direct supervision of teams.

· Proven track record running plant equipment, buildings, and preventive maintenance programs, and delivering capital projects within budget while working with outside vendors and contractors.

· Solid grounding in production planning, capacity and workforce planning, equipment reliability, quality systems, and Lean or process-improvement methods.

· Familiarity with ISO 9001:2015 is a plus.

· Strong interpersonal, communication, project management, organizational, and financial acumen.

· Bachelor’s degree preferred in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent experience will be considered.

**Benefits**

MDI offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

· Company-paid medical coverage for employees

· Life insurance

· Voluntary vision coverage

· Paid vacation time

· Paid holidays

· Profit-sharing plan

· On-site fitness facility available at no cost to employees

**Physical Requirement**

· Position requires constant walking or standing for an 8 + hour shift

· Must be able to lift and carry heavy items as needed

· Ability to move with ease around manufacturing equipment

Pay: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Life insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* manufacturing leadership: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**About the role**

**Krosswood Doors** builds residential interior and exterior doors in Tucson, Arizona, and sells them through The Home Depot and Krosswood.com. We build doors mostly one at a time, through manual and semi-automated processes, against a daily target of 400+ doors and lead times under three days.

The **Director of Operations** is the top plant leader in Tucson and owns every function and transaction at the site, from receiving raw material to shipping quality doors on time. The job: consistently deliver safe, high-quality products, on time, at the lowest sustainable cost, while developing people and building scalable systems. At our size, that means deep involvement in daily operations while building the organization for future growth.

You will partner closely with the SVP Operations on both daily execution and priorities. The SVP owns multi-year strategy, final budget and capital approval, the ERP roadmap and the executive relationship with The Home Depot. You will be the leader on the floor and the site’s main point of contact for every stakeholder.

**How we run the plant**

* Daily success: a steady and consistent flow of great doors, built safely and efficiently, with uncompromising quality. The system you will run and improve:
* Daily accountability system: production hard-start, morning stand-up, QA meeting, hourly board walks and daily close-out, backed by Leader Standard Work for every manager.
* Total Ownership: every process, machine, tool, task and space has one named owner and a documented standard.
* SQDC-P scoreboards: safety, quality, delivery, cost and people results by station, with a first pass yield (FPY) target of 95% or better.
* 6S and visual management: 6S (5S plus safety) at every station, standard work, operator and machine cards.
* Escalation: operator to lead in under 5 minutes, to manager in under 15, to Director of Operations in under 30, and to the SVP Operations in under 60.

**What you’ll do**

* Operational leadership: own the daily production plan and schedule, capacity planning, staffing, equipment and resource allocation; manage the hour-by-hour KPIs, remove bottlenecks and lead daily issue resolution.
* Safety: own safety culture, compliance, training, reporting, audits and corrective actions; make sure the daily safety cross is completed and every issue is resolved.
* Operational excellence: run and improve the production management system (daily and weekly accountability rhythms and KPIs); drive documented standard work, visual management, Lean, 6S, kaizen and labor utilization.
* Quality: build and own the quality management system: documented quality standards, FPY, escape prevention, defect reduction and root cause and corrective action, working with the Quality & Process Specialist.
* Delivery: drive throughput, flow and on-time delivery to homedepot.com; avoid and mitigate Home Depot fines; manage releases, PPR and duration exceptions; lead ERP (NetSuite) improvements with IT.
* Cost: own labor and material cost, labor utilization and budget adherence; align staffing, temp labor and overtime with sales volume; build capital (CAPEX) proposals and a continuous cost-improvement program.
* People: build an engaged culture; run performance management (reviews, scorecards, discipline), recognition, staffing and wages; develop your managers into leaders; own training and succession planning for direct labor.
* Warehouse: own inventory and transaction accuracy, documented SOPs and adherence, PPR and order management, staffing, material shortages and cost savings.
* Analysis: make data-based decisions; build system-based tools and KPIs; dig into the details to find wins, losses, risks and opportunities.
* Cross-functional: work with sales, purchasing, IT and finance to resolve issues and improve quality, delivery, cost and the customer experience; handle HR issues and site administration.
* Process knowledge: know each process well enough to spot when an operator, machine or function falls short of the expected result, then lead root cause analysis and corrective action.

**What you’ll bring**

Required

* 10+ years of manufacturing operations leadership in a high-mix, low-volume, custom or craft setting, including leading managers across production, warehouse and maintenance.
* Proven success implementing and sustaining Lean, 5S/6S and Kaizen.
* Has built and run a production management system: daily and weekly accountability rhythms, KPIs and visual management.
* Has built or improved a quality management system, with measurable gains in first pass yield and defect reduction.
* Owned an operating budget and built capital spending proposals; manages labor, temp staffing, overtime and material cost.
* Strong data skills: builds KPIs and reports, and uses data to find root causes and make decisions.
* Hands-on HR experience: performance reviews, discipline, wage adjustments, hiring and leadership development.
* Experience writing, enforcing and training SOPs and process documentation.
* Fluent in English and Spanish, able to communicate clearly with the whole workforce.
* Able to separate a process breakdown from process noncompliance, and respond to each the right way.
* A confident, hands-on leader with the discipline to hold the line and the patience to build people up.
* Bachelor’s degree in operations management, industrial engineering, engineering or business, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

* NetSuite or other ERP experience, including leading ERP improvements (strongly preferred).
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt.
* Preventive maintenance or TPM knowledge.
* Safety management and OSHA compliance experience.
* Wood products, doors, millwork, cabinetry or finishing background.
* Experience meeting retailer or e-commerce delivery requirements, such as The Home Depot.

**How success is measured**

Timeframe

* First 30 days - Knows every station and function; runs the daily accountability system alongside the SVP Operations; has met each manager one-on-one; understands the budget
* First 90 days - Runs the site independently; Leader Standard Work followed at every station; top 3 throughput, quality and cost losses named with action plans; 12-month improvement plan agreed with the SVP Operations
* Ongoing - 400+ doors a day at 95%+ FPY; zero lost-time injuries; on-time delivery with no fines; labor and material cost on budget; managers leading their areas on their own; systems that scale with growth

**Work environment and benefits**

This is a 100% on-site, floor-first role in an active manufacturing plant with machinery, noise, wood dust and finishing materials. PPE is provided and required.

**Benefits**: Medical, dental, 401(k), PTO and more

**Salary:** $72,000–$85,000 per year, based on experience, plus 10% annual bonus

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Advanced Mission Partners, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Science Systems and Applications, Inc (SSAI) seeks a Director of Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, and engineering services operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, optimizing manufacturing performance, managing resources, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products and engineering services. This position will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, improving profitability, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the company's continued growth. 
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aerospace and defense manufacturing, demonstrated leadership experience, and a proven ability to manage complex manufacturing operations while meeting demanding quality, cost, and delivery requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree (BS) in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in program management, project management, manufacturing operations, or engineering.
* At least 5 years of experience managing complex technical or manufacturing programs, preferably within the aerospace, defense, or electronics manufacturing industries.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations, managing budgets, and improving operational performance.
* Experience working with aerospace and defense customers, including government agencies, prime contractors, and commercial aerospace organizations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, engineering development, quality assurance, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and implementing operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing services (EMS), or precision manufacturing.
* Familiarity with printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), electronic systems integration, and aerospace manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
* Experience with government contracts, including FAR, DFARS, ITAR, and EAR requirements.
* Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM), program financial forecasting, and cost control methodologies.
* Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and project management software, such as Microsoft Project or equivalent tools.
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), production transitions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation, process optimization, and production scalability.

**EOE, including disability/vets**

***Physical Requirements:*** *While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and use hands to touch, handle or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk and hear and occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.*

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you will do::

As the Plant Manager, you will serve as the senior leader of the operation, with full responsibility for the facility's operational performance, customer experience, employee engagement, and financial results. You will lead a truss manufacturing business serving residential, commercial, multifamily, and agricultural construction markets while driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and a culture centered on safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will:

* Assume full P&L responsibility for the business, including revenue growth, gross margin performance, operating expenses, EBITDA, and overall profitability.
* Develop and execute business plans that drive market share growth, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Lead all day-to-day operations of the truss manufacturing facility, including production, engineering/design, purchasing, scheduling, inventory, logistics, maintenance, and quality.
* Partner with sales leadership to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships, expand market opportunities, and improve competitive positioning.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics, identify trends, and implement action plans that improve profitability and business results.
* Maintain accountability for budgeting, forecasting, cost management, capital expenditures, working capital, and inventory performance.
* Lead and develop supervisors, managers, and frontline team members while creating a high-performance culture focused on accountability and results.
* Champion safety, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives across all aspects of the operation.
* Ensure production capacity, staffing, and operational resources are aligned with customer demand and growth objectives.
* Foster strong relationships with contractors, builders, developers, architects, engineers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead change management initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that enhance operational performance and long-term scalability.
* Serve as the primary business leader for the operation, balancing customer needs, employee development, operational execution, and financial performance.

What you will bring::

* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in truss manufacturing, engineered wood products, building materials, lumber, component manufacturing, construction products, or a related industry.
* Proven success leading a manufacturing operation with direct P&L ownership and accountability for revenue, margin, and profitability.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, cost controls, pricing strategies, capital investments, and financial performance.
* Experience driving profitable growth through operational improvements, sales partnership, customer development, and market expansion.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams including operations, production, purchasing, engineering/design, logistics, and customer-facing functions.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, labor productivity, inventory management, throughput optimization, and supply chain operations.
* Experience building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.
* Proven ability to make data-driven business decisions and execute strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and leadership skills.

**Success in This Role**

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a business leader with the execution skills of an operations leader. This individual will take ownership of the entire operation, drive sustainable revenue and profitability growth, strengthen customer relationships, improve operational performance, and build an engaged, high-performing team. Success will be measured by the operation's safety performance, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and overall financial results.

What you will earn::

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

**QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. *It is the policy of the Company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, protected veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance submitting an application or would like to request an accommodation, please email us at careers@QXO.com to make a request.*

new_roles.title: Director of Plant Operations
new_roles.description:
Responsibilities:

**Director Of Plant Operations**

Full Time /Salaried

The Director of Plant Operations is responsible for the overall administration, coordination, and maintenance of the facility’s physical plant, buildings, grounds, and supporting infrastructure in accordance with applicable regulatory, safety, and operational standards. This role provides leadership and oversight of Plant Operations, including environment of care, life safety, emergency preparedness, maintenance, housekeeping, transportation, dietary support functions, and other facility-related services as assigned. The Director ensures that the hospital environment remains compliant with Joint Commission standards, applicable codes, and organizational policies through proactive monitoring, preventive maintenance, risk mitigation, and timely corrective action. The Director of Plant Operations monitors performance metrics, manages assigned staff and contractors, and ensures that all operations support the delivery of safe, effective patient care while maintaining full survey readiness at all times.

Arrowhead Behavioral Health is a 48-bed psychiatric hospital located in Maumee, Ohio. We serve adult patients 18 years of age and older that need mental health and chemical dependency services. Inpatient offerings include treatment for drug and alcohol withdrawal management and stabilization as well as mental health crisis management. Our outpatient services extend the continuum of care to include partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient programs which allow patients to develop and utilize proper coping mechanisms to help establish a foundation for life. Additionally, we offer a Relapse Prevention Program along with a Medication Administration Program to support patients in maintaining lifelong sobriety.

 
Qualifications:

Education: Bachelors Degree in related fields

Work Experience: 3-5 years in maintance and operations

Leadership Experience: 1-3 years

Essential Functions of the Job/Responisbilites:

* Directs, coordinates, and evaluates all plant operations functions, including maintenance, utilities, and support services, to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable facility performance
* Directs and provides maintenance services to ensure timely repair and preventive maintenance of physical structures, equipment, and building systems including responding to urgent maintenance issues and after-hours emergencies as needed to maintain a safe environment. Maintains records related to maintenance, inspections, work orders, and compliance activities
* Monitors the operation and condition of critical systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire alarm, fire suppression, life safety, boilers, generators, and other essential building systems.
* Ensures compliance with applicable safety regulations, environmental standards, and organizational policies and maintains accurate records of inspections, maintenance activities, repairs, incidents, training, compliance documentation, and corrective actions.
* Supervise housekeeping operations and steps in providing coverage or support housekeeping services as needed.
* Oversees transportation, dietary support services, and other facility-related operational functions as assigned.
* Recruits, trains, schedules, supervises, and evaluates staff; addresses performance issues and supports staff development and accountability.
* Coordinates vendor, contractor, and service provider relationships, including scope development, bid review, scheduling, performance oversight, and contract compliance
* Tracks and analyzes operational metrics such as work order completion rates, response times, system uptime, safety performance, and regulatory compliance
* Performs other duties as assigned to support hospital operations and patient care

Previous experience in a mental health or substance abuse treatment facility preferred, but we will train the right person.

This individual must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills. Diplomacy and discretion are essential, as well as excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple projects. Professional demeanor and appearance required.

Salary (exempt) Position

Hours based off 40 hour week, but may very or extend due to workload, projects or emergencies.

Must be willing to be on call for any faucitliy emergency

Arrowhead Behavioral Health offers an excellent time off plan, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, short and long term disability benefits and 401(k) plan for full time and part time employees.

We are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability. We embrace diversity in our people, services and ideas. While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

*Arrowhead Behavioral Health is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Arrowhead Behavioral Health via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Arrowhead Behavioral Health. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Arrowhead Behavioral Health as a result of the referral or through other means.* *Applications are only accepted via the online submission program. Paper application and resumes are not accepted.*

EEO Statement

All UHS subsidiaries are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates. UHS subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers and as such, openly support and fully commit to recruitment, selection, placement, promotion and compensation of individuals without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), genetic information, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success.

Notice

At UHS and all our subsidiaries, our Human Resources departments and recruiters are here to help prospective candidates by matching skillset and experience with the best possible career path at UHS and our subsidiaries. We take pride in creating a highly efficient and best in class candidate experience. During the recruitment process, no recruiter or employee will request financial or personal information (Social Security Number, credit card or bank information, etc.) from you via email. The recruiters will not email you from a public webmail client like Hotmail, Gmail, Yahoo Mail, etc. If you are suspicious of a job posting or job-related email mentioning UHS or its subsidiaries, let us know by contacting us at: https://uhs.alertline.com or 1-800-852-3449.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
SET THE VISION. LEAD WITH PURPOSE. DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE.

Plant Manager | Full-Time | Salary

AUTOKINITON | Chicago, IL (relocation available)

Are you an experienced manufacturing leader who knows how to bring people together, strengthen operations, and turn business goals into measurable results? At AUTOKINITON, you'll have the opportunity to lead an entire plant, develop future leaders, and drive the safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance that keep our business moving forward.

WHO WE ARE

At AUTOKINITON, our work helps shape the vehicles people drive every day. As a trusted partner to the world's leading automakers, we take pride in building high-quality structural components that contribute to vehicle strength, durability, and safety. But what truly drives our success is our people. Guided by our core value, “We, Not I,” we believe in teamwork, continuous improvement, and creating opportunities for every associate to contribute, grow, and succeed. Join a team where your leadership makes a difference, your ideas drive improvement, and we're building the future of mobility together.

PURPOSE: WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Plant Manager, you'll provide strategic and hands-on leadership across all plant operations, building a strong team while delivering results for our customers and our business.

* Lead Plant Performance: Direct daily operations to achieve safety, quality, productivity, delivery, and financial goals.

* Develop Strong Leaders: Coach, mentor, and develop the leadership team and salaried associates, building accountability and future management talent.

* Drive Business Results: Own plant financial performance, manage budgets and staffing levels, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

* Build a Culture of Safety: Lead plant safety initiatives, strengthen EHS accountability, and ensure compliance with company policies and OSHA requirements.

* Improve Operations: Champion lean manufacturing, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

* Deliver for Customers: Build strong customer relationships, lead customer visits and presentations, and ensure plant performance consistently meets or exceeds expectations.

* Shape the Business Strategy: Develop and execute the plant's strategic business plan, aligning measurable goals with broader North American business objectives.

* Support Growth and Innovation: Partner with commercial, engineering, and program teams on new business opportunities, customer launches, plant capacity, and operational readiness.

* Strengthen Teamwork: Create an engaged, collaborative environment where associates have the resources, direction, and support to succeed.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT?

* Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field; preference for Manufacturing, Engineering, or Quality. Master's degree preferred.

* Minimum of 8-10 years of manufacturing leadership experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Department Manager, with metals manufacturing experience preferred, with at least 5 years within a weld and assembly facility.

* Experience with Just-in-Time (JIT) manufacturing, including production scheduling, inventory management, and material flow principles.

* Experience leading new program launches and implementing lean manufacturing principles.

* Proven ability to lead, coach, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to interpret operating metrics and financial performance data.

* Knowledge of quality and environmental management systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO 14001.

* Excellent organizational, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; QAD and supply chain experience preferred.

* Ability to translate business strategies and progressive manufacturing practices into measurable operational improvements.

WHY BUILD YOUR CAREER WITH AUTOKINITON?

* Competitive compensation

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage

* 401(k) company contribution and match

* Up to 15 paid holidays, including our holiday bridge schedule

* Tuition reimbursement

* Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities

* A collaborative, team-focused culture built on continuous improvement

READY TO LEAD THE WAY?

Bring your leadership experience, business mindset, and passion for manufacturing to AUTOKINITON. Apply today and help drive the future of our business!

AUTOKINITON promotes a dynamic and collaborative work environment for everyone.

AUTOKINITON is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. AUTOKINITON makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations Maintenance
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) is responsible for overseeing and coordinating production personnel activities and ensuring accurate and timely completion of associated documentation in support ofensuring the operation and maintenance of production (prep, compounding, and filling) machinery and mechanical equipment in compliance with all safety policies, cGMPs, and SOPs. This role works cross-functionally with quality, engineering, manufacturing, technical transfer, and validation. The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) will rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals, which include organizing hourly employees in the performance of their duties, driving productivity to achieve optimum results, coordinating labor needs in support of minimizing active batch downtime and preventative maintenance schedule attainment. Additionally, the Operations Maintenance Manager (Production) oversees special project for process improvements to the manufacturing process. This position supports the ongoing development, manufacture, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in compliance with local procedures, corporate policies, and the regulatory requirements of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a sterile environment in the clean room by complying with garbing and behavior requirements that align to established cGMP practices and techniques
* Enforce/follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety policies, batch records, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), including Data Integrity and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP)
* Manage the operations maintenance (production) team to perform responsibilities associated with the troubleshooting/repair/preventative maintenance of GMP utilities and GMP pharmaceutical processing equipment, as well as accurate and timely completion of associated documentation
* Ensure operations maintenance (production) team members adequately support the production operations teams (Prep, Compounding and Fill) with equipment changeovers, set-ups, and start-up activities
* Ensure accurate and complete spare parts inventories are maintained
* Plan and execute operations maintenance (production) shut down/start up activities
* Conduct employee reviews and provide coaching as appropriate; maintain performance and attendance records
* Improve existing processes and/or equipment functionality in order to improve operational efficiency
* Assist with deviation investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and other documents as needed
* Manage the maintenance operations (production) team to execute support requests from manufacturing, technical transfer, validation, and engineering
* Ensure self and direct reports are trained and work in compliance with applicable SOPs, cGMPs, regulatory requirements, safety, environmental, mechanical/electrical maintenance/troubleshooting principles, and company policies
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Skills:**

* Ability to comply with and enforce aseptic practices and cleanroom behavior
* Ability to lead a maintenance team to efficiently and accurately execute repairs/preventative maintenance activities designed to minimize active batch downtime
* Ability to hold employees accountable for accurate, complete and timely task execution
* Must display sound judgment, ability to seek guidance, and provide clear directions
* Strong analytical, listening, verbal/written communication, achieve accuracy without being rushed, efficient time-management, problem-solving, attention to detail, prioritization, organization, interpersonal, computer and conflict management skills
* Ability to read and understand wiring diagrams and P&ID and possess a basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems
* Knowledge of lock out tag out procedures
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs without assistance

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* BS degree in Engineering (or related field) preferred. An appropriate mix of education and experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* 7+ years industrial maintenance experience (preferably in an aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment) and minimally 3-5 years of leadership experience preferred
* Experience with (or knowledge of) programmable logic controllers and/or Distributed Control Systems is preferred
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical manufacturing systems including PMS (particle measuring systems) and air monitoring systems, high purity water systems (WFI), HVAC equipment and systems, compressors, air/gas supply and distribution, plant and clean steam generation and distribution, refrigeration equipment, vacuum systems, and waste collection/drainage systems, as well as pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment (filling machines, washers, loaders, depyrogenation ovens, autoclaves, lyophilizer, etc) is also preferred
* Experience with maintenance and operation of manufacturing equipment in an active aseptic or terminally sterilized manufacturing environment preferred
* Experience with computerized Maintenance Management Systems like Blue Mountain or equivalent preferred

new_roles.title: Director Operations
new_roles.description:
**Requisition ID: 273115**

**Locations: Charlotte**

**Uncap Your Potential at America's Largest Coca-Cola Bottler — Pour Your Passion into Purpose!**

We're more than beverages—we're building meaningful careers and vibrant communities. Join our team where your talent meets purpose, and every teammate directly shapes our success.

* **Career Growth:** Clear pathways to advance and develop your career
* **Competitive Benefits:** 401(k) match + health coverage + employee stock purchase plan
* **Purpose-Driven:** Create meaningful impact in the communities you serve
* **Professional Development:** Dedicated training + personalized mentorship

**Join us - your refreshing new chapter starts here!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director, Operations leads and coordinates the overall operational efforts of the Manufacturing center and provides leadership and direction for the Production, Quality Assurance, Maintenance and, or Building Maintenance teams. Promotes a team environment and fosters cooperative relationships with all internal and external customers and suppliers; while developing and directing a plan which ensures high production efficiencies, a safe work environment, and production of the highest quality product.

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Direct, manage, lead, and motivate the quality, maintenance, and production teams to deliver results by communicating company goals (including quality and customer satisfaction), safety practices, and deadlines; recruiting and retaining; engaging and developing teammates through effective performance management, coaching, and training; implementing continuous improvement methods while maintaining customer focus; and embodying company purpose and values to inspire servant leadership
* Oversee compliance with all Consolidated Management Systems, ISO standards, and quality agency requirements to ensure product quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and efficient operations
* Facilitate cross-functional actions to drive continuous improvement in production, quality, and safety
* Develop and manage expense, capital, and labor budgets to support CCCI’s budgeting, cost-related decision-making, and long-term financial planning
* Ensure the satisfaction of all internal and external customers, CCCI plants, and Corporate functions and develop strong partnerships with suppliers

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

* 5-7 years of previous experience in manufacturing Food and Beverage industry experience preferred
* Management Systems experience, ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, SQF
* Ability to lead, manage, and develop a team
* Computer skills – SAP, Microsoft Office Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage constant change in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Ability to plan and execute complex projects
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time, walking manufacturing floor, climbing stairs, and lift up to 25lbs

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree (4 years)
* Knowledge acquired through 5 to up to 7 years of work experience
* Valid Driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business

**Work Environment**
--------------------

Noisy, wet, and extreme temperature environment

Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Plant Manager

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Job Overview:**

The primary responsibilities include managing all day-to-day plant operations. Manage and lead a team of production and warehouse employees. Responsible to improve efficiency, cost, quality, and safety through both individual and team contributions.

**Essential Responsibilities**:

* Supervise all plant operations including production and warehouse departments.
* Coordinate departmental activities to fulfill sales orders, meet inventory requirements and deliver manufactured products in a timely fashion.
* Manage staff, prepare work schedules, and assign specific duties in production. Establish and implement departmental policies, goals, objectives, and procedures, conferring with other department directors as necessary.
* Maintains communication and coaching to employees on a daily basis to ensure they have the information to do their jobs and that they understand and adhere to the goals and direction of the company.
* Trains direct reports on operating procedures, quality standards, environmental, health and safety procedures, and company policies. Ensures compliance and sustainment of training to ensure a smooth operation.
* Determine staffing requirements, and participate in the recruiting process i.e., interview, hire and train new employees.
* Provides performance and daily corrective feedback to employees as needed. Writes direct reports performance reviews. Recommends raises next level of discipline and terminations to Director of Operations and Human Resources Manager.
* Respond to emergency department requests. Troubleshoot issues to determine cause and solution.
* Participate in all shifts as necessary to assure the department is streamlined.
* Collaborates with other departments on projects as needed.
* Communicate regularly with plant personnel to maintain a high level of morale.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Familiarity with manufacturing environments, and ability to apply fundamental troubleshooting skills to technical problems.
* Familiarity with Continuous Improvement, LEAN, and six-sigma.
* Familiarity with meeting OSHA standards and leading a culture of safety first.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities, identify and addresses problems and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively with a wide array of personnel.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Computer skills to include ERP system and Microsoft programs. Must be able to use computer programs to keep track of administrative tasks such as report writing, analysis of work orders, evaluations of production estimates and outputs.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to talk with groups of employees as well as strong one-on-one communication skills to facilitate employee engagement.
* Must be committed to the success of the entire organization.

**Physical Requirements:**

Requirements include, but are not limited to:

* Works in both an office environment and a warehouse.
* Requires sitting, operating a computer keyboard, telephone, and other office equipment for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged periods of time as required to the walk-shop floor.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Must be able to perform repetitive motions such as reaching and grasping.

* The work environment is in a warehouse/production and temperatures inside vary between hot and cold based on the outside conditions.
* This is a fast-paced environment with constantly changing priorities.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field required.
* 10+ years leading a team in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in the plastic bottle industry, or in a manufacturing environment, is highly preferred
* Must be "hands-on" and assist in completing department goals as required.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance premium.
* Employer-paid Life Insurance
* Employer Match

new_roles.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven **Senior Operations Manager** to lead and optimize operations within a fast-paced e-commerce logistics environment. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, ensuring customer satisfaction, maximizing productivity, and leading large teams across multiple shifts. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong background in distribution, fulfillment, logistics, and continuous improvement.

**About the Role**
------------------

**How you will contribute**

* Manage the daily activities of a logistics operation to maximize scheduling and delivery of commodities to the customer.
* Interface with customer to ensure smooth -coordination of scheduling and maximization of schedule adherence; provides input on local conditions, identifies needs and receives direction on real-time staffing increases or decreases.
* Enact contingency plans as needed; escalate and direct activities during system problems, disasters, etc.; identify potential problems, troubleshoot, escalate issues to local and senior management, and participate in post-mortem analysis of problems providing input for future process improvements.
* Review ongoing performance results to targets. Take corrective measures with authorization, escalate as needed
* Responsible for providing effective leadership to the Warehouse Managers and/or team, enforcing company standards, act as a role model.
* Other duties as assigned.
 

**Your Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related field preferred.
* At least 5 Years of Progressive experience performing professional level operational and plant management duties; preferably in automotive or logistics industry.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or complaints. Ability to write documents using original or innovative techniques or style. Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations on controversial or complex topics to top management and customer.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Proficient personal computer skills including electronic mail, record keeping, routine database activity, word processing, spreadsheet, graphics, etc.

**Compensation**

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package. The pay range for this role is $115,000 to 135,000, paid bi-weekly, with the potential for annual bonus payable in April every year. Company-offered benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with up to 4% Company match, paid time off, Company-paid Basic Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability insurance, plus addtional voluntary and supplemental options and wellness programs.

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

The DP World family comprises of syncreon, Imperial and P&O.

**WE MAKE TRADE FLOW**

**TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.**

 

**Nearest Major Market:** Riverside
 
**Nearest Secondary Market:** Los Angeles
 
**Job Segment:** Accounts Payable, Operations Manager, Logistics, Supply Chain Manager, Manager, Finance, Operations, Management

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Santa Maria Independent School District

**Job Title:** Operations Director **Exemption Status/Test:** Exempt

**Reports to:** Superintendent of Schools

**Dept./School:** Operations Department **Date Revised: 11/2026**

Primary Purpose:

Direct and manage district’s maintenance, transportation, and custodial operations. Ensure safe and efficient operation of transportation department. Oversee maintenance of all district-owned vehicles. Maintain physical school plant in excellent operating condition so that full educational use may be made at all times. Provide a physical environment that is functional, safe, clean, and attractive.

Qualifications:

Education/Certification:

Clear and valid Texas commercial driver’s license with Passenger (P) and School Bus (S) endorsements

Special Knowledge/Skills:

Ability to direct and manage operations of school buses and operations inventory 
Knowledge of basic principles of construction, school plant maintenance, and custodial operations

Ability to pass U.S. Department of Transportation alcohol and drug tests and annual physical exam

Knowledge of energy management and vehicle repair and maintenance

Ability to conduct on-site inspections of all vehicle repair and maintenance operations

Ability to manage budget and personnel

Ability to implement policy and procedures

Ability to interpret data and learn transportation routes

Ability to use technology to plan, operate, monitor, and evaluate transportation operations

Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

Experience:

1-3 years’ supervisory experience in transportation and maintenance operations

1-3 years’ experience as a bus driver

Major Responsibilities and Duties:Building Maintenance and Repair

1. Ensure district facilities are functional, safe, clean, and well maintained.

2. Develop and maintain written departmental procedures for maintenance, repair, and operations of all district buildings and equipment. Ensure work orders are processed and executed in a timely manner.

3. Prepare plans and specifications for contracted repair work and site improvement for submission to purchasing department for bids.

Transportation and Vehicle Maintenance Operations

4. Manage the delivery of transportation services for students and ensure they are picked up and arrive safely and on time.

5. Oversee preparation and updating of bus routes and schedules for all schools in district and develop plans to meet future transportation needs.

6. Communicate changes in routes and scheduling to campuses and the public when warranted.

7. Coordinate transportation for extracurricular activities and special programs.

8. Assign bus drivers to routes and extracurricular trips and find substitutes as needed.

9. Monitor fuel deliveries and distribution.

10. Oversee repair of all district-owned vehicles and preventive maintenance. Ensure vehicle repair requests and work orders are prioritized and processed in a timely manner. Contract for outside services that cannot be performed in shop.

Policy, Reports, and Laws

11. Implement federal and state law, State Board of Education rule, and board policy.

12. Compile, maintain, file, and present all reports, records, and other documents required.

13. Prepare, process, and maintain all documents required to verify safety certification and alcohol and drug testing of bus drivers.

14. Ensure employee time records are accurately maintained and data necessary to process transportation payroll is delivered in a timely manner.

15. Follow district safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Budget and Inventory

16. Develop and administer budget based on documented needs and ensure operations are cost effective and funds are managed wisely.

17. Maintain current inventory of supplies and parts and initiate purchases in accordance with budgetary limitations and district policies. Approve and forward invoices for transportation to accounting department.

18. Recommend disposal of obsolete or worn out vehicles and equipment. Recommend purchase of vehicles as necessary.

Student Management

19. Implement district’s student discipline policies and ensure expectations about appropriate behavior when using district transportation are communicated to students. Enforce student discipline and suspension of riding privileges for any student who violates rules and regulations.

20. Investigate reported concerns and take appropriate action to resolve issues.

Personnel

21. Select, train, supervise, and evaluate staff and make recommendations relative to assignment, retention, discipline, and dismissal.

Safety

22. Enforce safety standards that conform with state, federal, and insurance regulations and develop a program of preventive safety.

23. Ensure equipment is maintained in optimum operating condition.

24. Maintain safety standards in conformance with federal, state, and insurance regulations and district requirements and develop a program of preventive safety.

25. Assess road conditions and hazards and advise administration about inclement weather conditions that may result in delayed starts or the closing of schools.

26. Investigate school bus accidents and student safety violations.

27. Maintain safety standards in conformance with federal, state, and insurance regulations.

28. Organize and conduct training programs to promote a safe work environment.

29. Ensure transportation equipment is in excellent operating condition.

30. Follow district safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Other

31. Participate in development of the district’s disaster plan and be prepared to take an active role in responding to emergencies as needed.

32. Operate bus and district vehicles as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Supervise, evaluate, and recommend the hiring and firing of maintenance and transportation employees

Mental Demands/Physical Demands/Environmental Factors:

**Tools/Equipment Used:** Standard office equipment including computer and peripherals; district vehicle; school bus

Posture: Prolonged sitting; frequent standing, kneeling/squatting, bending/stooping, pushing/pulling, and twistingMotion: Frequent walking; regular grasping/squeezing, wrist flexion/extension, and reaching; regular drivingLifting: Regular light lifting and carrying (less than 15 pounds)Environment: Work outside and inside, on slippery or uneven walking surfaces; frequent exposure to extreme hot and cold temperatures, dust, noise, vibration; exposure to chemical hazards; work around vehicles and machinery with moving parts; regularly work irregular hours; occasional prolonged hours; frequent districtwide travel; occasional statewide travelMental Demands: Maintain emotional control under stress

*\*To meet the executive exemption test, the primary duty must be management* ***and*** *the employee must supervise at least two full-time employees.*

This document describes the general purpose and responsibilities assigned to this job and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties that may be assigned or skills that may be required.

**It is the policy of Santa Maria ISD not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex or handicap in its vocational programs, services or activities as required by Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended; Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972; and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended.**

Pay: $198.72 - $280.08 per day

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Retirement plan

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

new_roles.description:
Description:

Position: Director of Operations

Company: GlobalMed Logistix (GMLx)

**Position Summary**

GMLx seeks a Director of Operations with a strong foundation in leadership, analytical problem-solving, and execution in complex, time-sensitive environments. This leader will oversee medical-device logistics, product, and customer service across multiple facilities and service lines, ensuring reliable surgical support while developing people, improving processes, and building capacity for growth.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, customer-oriented leader who has led teams through demanding situations, translated ambiguous objectives into practical operating plans, and delivered measurable improvements. Prior medical-device industry experience is not required; the ability to learn quickly, exercise sound judgment, and lead effectively is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead operations: Direct daily execution across assigned facilities and service lines, including surgical case fulfillment, inventory movement, customer service, and transportation coordination.
* Develop people and teams: Lead managers, supervisors, and frontline employees. Establish clear expectations, coach emerging leaders, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Translate strategy into execution: Turn business priorities into operating plans with defined responsibilities, resource requirements, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Improve operational performance: Identify constraints, redesign workflows, and implement sustainable improvements in service reliability, productivity, quality, and cost.
* Plan resources and capacity: Develop staffing models, capacity forecasts, and budget recommendations that balance current demands with future growth.
* Use data to drive decisions: Establish meaningful performance measures, investigate underlying causes of problems, and communicate findings and recommendations to executive leadership.
* Lead technology initiatives: Translate operational needs into business requirements. Partner with technical teams and vendors to test, implement, and improve systems that support execution and visibility.
* Manage customer and partner relationships: Build productive relationships with manufacturers, sales organizations, transportation providers, and internal stakeholders. Resolve escalations, support customer business reviews, contribute

operational insight to new-business pursuits, and align expectations with operational capabilities.

* Lead through disruptions: Make timely decisions under pressure, coordinate responses across teams, and maintain continuity of service when conditions change.
* Support business expansion: Develop the processes, staffing, training, and infrastructure required to onboard customers and launch new services.
* Establish operating discipline: Create clear procedures, strengthen communication and handoffs, and ensure corrective actions address the causes of recurring problems.

new_roles.title: Director of Offshore Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Endurance**
===================

Endurance is building the world's first modular subsea geothermal power plants, converting vast thermal resources under the ocean into gigawatts of baseload power. Backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, First Round Capital, and Point72 Ventures, our founding team includes veterans from SpaceX, Helion, Blue Origin, and Apple. We have completed multiple deep-ocean deployments to subsea volcanoes and are launching a long-term demonstration project this fall. By leveraging modular design, manufacturing scale, efficient drilling, and latent cooling on the seafloor, we are pioneering a new category of energy that outperforms traditional sources on environmental impact, deployment speed, and cost.

**Responsibilities**

* Own offshore readiness and execution end to end: plan each campaign from mission objectives through vessel, equipment, crew, schedule, and budget, and deliver it safely, on time, and at cost
* Select vessels for each mission: translate mission requirements into vessel requirements for deck space and strength, lifting capacity, station keeping, accommodation, and endurance; evaluate and inspect candidates; make the trade between capability, availability, and cost
* Negotiate and manage charter agreements and offshore service contracts; understand the day rates, liabilities, and terms that drive total campaign cost, and hold vessel owners and contractors to them
* Own marine insurance for our vessels, equipment, and operations; work directly with brokers, underwriters, and marine warranty surveyors, and make sure our engineering and procedures meet their requirements
* Personally perform the design and analysis for equipment mobilizations: deck layouts, seafastening and grillage design, lift plans, vessel stability and motions, and launch and recovery loads; know when independent review or class approval is required and obtain it without losing schedule
* Plan and lead mobilizations and demobilizations: port selection, shipping and customs, installation on deck, function testing, and readiness reviews before the vessel leaves the dock
* Own maintenance and readiness of all offshore assets, including ROVs, drilling systems, launch and recovery equipment, and rigging; establish maintenance programs, spares, and certifications so equipment works when it reaches site
* Define staffing for offshore campaigns and asset maintenance: decide what we hire, contract, and train; establish crew plans, rotations, and competency requirements; recruit and lead the team as it grows
* Lead campaigns offshore as the senior Endurance representative: direct operations with the vessel master and crew, make weather and operability decisions, resolve problems as they occur, and turn each campaign's lessons into better equipment and procedures
* Move aggressively while maintaining exceptional technical rigor and safe operations: set the standard for risk assessments and offshore procedures, surface risks immediately, and drive recovery rather than wait for clean requirements or instructions

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in naval architecture, ocean, mechanical, or structural engineering, or a related engineering discipline
* 10+ years of experience in offshore operations, subsea construction, marine installation, or a comparably demanding offshore environment
* A record of leading offshore campaigns as the person accountable for the outcome, including time at sea directing operations
* Experience personally performing mobilization engineering, such as deck layouts, seafastening design, and lift planning, not only reviewing the work of others
* Direct experience selecting and chartering vessels, including negotiating charter terms with vessel owners and brokers
* Experience owning the maintenance and operational readiness of offshore equipment, with independent responsibility for technical and commercial decisions under uncertainty
* Willingness and ability to spend around two months per year offshore, to travel regularly beyond that to vessels, ports, and suppliers, and to obtain the required offshore medical and safety certifications

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Degree or professional background in naval architecture, with hands-on experience in vessel stability, motions analysis, and structural analysis of deck equipment and foundations
* Experience operating and maintaining work-class ROVs, subsea or seabed drilling systems, and launch and recovery systems
* Experience working with marine warranty surveyors, classification societies, and marine insurers to gain approval for offshore operations
* Experience executing campaigns from remote ports, including international shipping, customs, and local port and agent logistics
* Experience with deepwater operations, heavy subsea lifts, or installation of large equipment on the seafloor

• • A record of building an offshore operations function or team at a small or fast-growing company, including hiring, contracting, and crewing

**Compensation, Benefits, & Perks**
===================================

As a pre-revenue startup, Endurance Energy offers competitive base salaries and generous equity packages for full-time employees. Final base salary will be determined by an array of factors including internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and work experience.

A key aspect of our compensation philosophy is that value creation should be aligned with rewards. Right now this means equity is a significant portion of every full-time employee's compensation. As the company matures, there will be continued evolution and changes to the total rewards and total compensation package. What will always be true is that if we win, we win together. Equity is granted to every full-time employee as a meaningful piece of ownership. We believe the people building the company should share directly in the value they create.

In addition to a competitive base salary and equity, employees will receive all of our other great benefits and perks, including:

* **Benefits**: Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage
* **Time Away:** Flexible PTO including 12 paid company holidays
* **Global Fieldwork**: Travel to fascinating deployment sites along oceanic ridges in locations like the Pacific Northwest, Hawaii, Iceland, Japan, New Zealand, and the Azores
* **Hands-on Experience**: Participate in sea trials and deployment operations in partnership with leading oceanographic institutions
* **Cutting-edge Development**: Work with technology that spans high-power electronics, marine systems, and clean energy
* **Impactful Work**: Help solve one of the world's most pressing challenges
* **Dive Certification**: Company-sponsored recreational dive certification
* **Other Perks:** Access to the company boat, free meals and snacks, and the list goes on!

If you’re selected for consideration, a recruiter will be able to discuss in greater detail.

Compensation Range: $225K - $275K
