new_roles.title: Director, Faculty Practice Operations
new_roles.description:
The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

 

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu .

**Job Description**

The Orvis School of Nursing at the University of Nevada, Reno is recruiting for a Director of Faculty Practice Operations within the Office of Strategic Partnerships and Practice (OSPP). The Director of Faculty Practice Operations provides senior-level operational, managerial, and partnership execution leadership for the Office of Strategic Partnerships and Practice (OSPP). This role is responsible for the day-to-day operations and growth of all OSPP practice sites and initiatives, ensuring efficient, compliant, and sustainable operations in alignment with strategic priorities established by the Associate Dean for Strategic Partnerships and Practice (ADSPP). The Director brings strong business and financial acumen, practice management experience, grants and contracts experience, and expertise in community-based partnerships. This position will possess a working knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, medical billing and coding, revenue cycle management, and payer contracting processes in insurance-reimbursed clinical environments. The Director operationalizes strategy through strong infrastructure, systems, partnerships, and team leadership and assumes operational accountability for the financial, compliance, and reputational risk associated with OSPP practice sites, partnerships, and funded initiatives.

 

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree and four (4) years of related professional work experience; **OR**

Master’s degree and two (2) years of related professional work experience.

**Related Experience** : Progressively responsible experience in practice management, operations, partnerships, or related leadership roles; experience in healthcare reimbursement, medical billing, coding, and revenue cycle processes, including the ability to work effectively with payer contracts, compliance requirements, and practice finance operations; experience working in a practice environment with evolving priorities and operational needs; people management and team leadership experience or a related field.

 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master of Healthcare Administration (MHA)
* Eligible for RN licensure in Nevada
* Experience in academic health sciences, higher education, or community-based organizations
* Experience supporting faculty practice, community-engaged scholarship, or interprofessional initiatives
A demonstrated commitment to equity, community engagement, and collaboration 

 

**Schedule and Travel Requirements**

* Variable work schedule
Occasional travel may be required 

**Compensation Grade**

Administrative Faculty – C

The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience.

Today, the University delivers on its original land-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education.

new_roles.title: Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch
new_roles.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**LOCATION:** Remote with Travel

US Valve is growing rapidly, driven by critical customer demand in data center and other high-growth markets, creating increasingly complex new product development programs with multiple manufacturing paths. The Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch will build and lead the function responsible for taking these programs from business case through stable production, whether manufactured at US Valve, at sister IDEX business units, through external supply chain partners, or through a hybrid model. The role ensures that product design, manufacturing processes, suppliers, supply chain, quality systems, and commercial launch mature together against one integrated plan.

This leader is the single point of accountability for integrated NPI execution and owns end-to-end program results, including schedule, budget, quality, supplier readiness, manufacturing readiness, launch readiness, and ramp performance. The role organizes Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Sales, Finance, BU partners, and external suppliers under one plan. The Director ensures APQP and launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections, are completed on time and to standard. Success isn't design release; it is demonstrating that the full value stream can repeatedly meet customer demand with the required quality, cost, and delivery performance.

The right leader is a builder and results driver with the technical and operational credibility to walk the factory floor, challenge supplier capacity, identify manufacturing constraints, and lead cross-functional recovery. This person establishes the PMO, sets objective gate criteria and metrics, holds functional leaders and partners accountable without direct authority, challenges unrealistic plans, and leads recovery when programs fall behind. The leader will model IDEX values of trust, team, and excellence and build a high-performing team that scales with the business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Build and Lead the Function***

* Build and lead the Program Management Office (PMO), including organizational structure, staffing plan, talent development, and succession for program and launch managers.
* Establish standard NPD governance—stage-gate/tollgate process, templates, operating cadence, and decision rights—aligned with the IDEX Operating Model.
* Define objective gate-exit criteria and recommend Go, Conditional Go, Hold, or Re-scope decisions based on demonstrated evidence.
* Own the NPD and launch portfolio; prioritize programs using 80/20 principles and align resources to the highest-value customer and growth opportunities.
* Lead executive-level business case, tollgate, and launch-readiness reviews, driving clear decisions on scope, investment, timing, and manufacturing path.

***IDEX Connected Growth and Cross-BU Leadership***

* Drive programs across multiple sister IDEX business units, leveraging IDEX connected growth strategies to share capacity, technology, capabilities, and supply chain.
* Organize and align BU partners, supply chain partners, and internal manufacturing teams into a single integrated execution plan for each program.
* Maintain one integrated critical path and one objective program status across product, supplier, tooling, manufacturing, quality, material, and customer workstreams.
* Lead make, buy, partner, intercompany, and contract manufacturing strategies, including location, capacity, Capex, tooling, staffing, and timing.
* Establish cross-BU agreements, roles, and communication cadences that ensure clear accountability for deliverables across sites and partners.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance to align program strategy with BU and IDEX growth objectives.

***Quality Management and Launch Readiness Across Supply Chain Partners***

* Drive quality management across multiple supply chain partners, sister BUs, and internal sites to ensure consistent standards from development through production.
* Ensure APQP and product launch deliverables are completed on time and to standard, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, process flow diagrams, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections.
* Partner with Quality and Supply Chain to qualify, develop, and audit suppliers and contract manufacturers, and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Lead launch-readiness and production-readiness gates, ensuring no program advances without required quality, validation, and capacity evidence.
* Separate product validation from production-rate validation; require evidence that the complete value stream can repeatedly achieve required volume, yield, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive post-launch stabilization, ensuring yield, quality, and delivery targets are met before handoff to steady-state operations.

***Advanced Manufacturing and Capacity***

* Identify and drive advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and technologies needed to meet critical customer demand and scale production.
* Drive readiness of critical processes including welding and joining, filtration media and filter manufacturing, precision machining, assembly, automation, and production test.
* Lead capacity planning and implementation of new processes, including equipment selection, CapEx justification, facility changes, validation, and ramp plans.
* Partner with equipment providers, consultants, and IDEX sites to accelerate process development and transfer best practices.
* Champion design for manufacturability, lean, and continuous improvement in all new product introductions.
* Ensure process qualification, fixtures, tooling, controls, operator readiness, capacity, and rate trials are incorporated before design freeze and production release.

***Metrics, Visibility, and Results***

* Define and own program and launch KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear leadership visibility across BUs and partners.
* Identify risks early—schedule, resource, quality, sourcing, cost, capacity, and production readiness—and drive countermeasures and recovery plans.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines, resource assumptions, and commitments; escalate decisions and support needs to executive leadership.
* Deliver regular executive updates on portfolio status, risks, decisions, and results.
* Travel domestically and internationally up to 25% to support program execution, supplier engagement, site coordination, customer needs, and equipment-provider activities.
* Perform other related duties and support additional program, PMO, or business needs as assigned.

**KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS:**

* On-time milestone and launch attainment across the NPD portfolio.
* PPAP on-time completion and first-pass approval rate across internal sites, sister BUs, and supply chain partners.
* PFMEA, DFMEA, and control plan completion prior to required gates.
* Launch quality, including first-pass yield, PPM, and escapes at launch and 90 days post-launch.
* Ramp-to-rate performance, including time to target capacity and on-time delivery to customers.
* Critical manufacturing process readiness, including qualification and demonstrated capability for welding/joining, filtration manufacturing, machining, assembly, and test as applicable.
* Program budget, Capex, and product cost performance versus business case.
* Supplier and partner quality and delivery performance on launch programs.
* New product and IDEX-connected growth revenue enabled.
* PMO team capability, staffing, and retention.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven leader who has built and scaled a PMO, NPD launch, or program management function in a manufacturing environment.
* undefined
* Deep experience with APQP and product launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, and production part qualification.
* Track record driving quality and launch execution across multiple supply chain partners, contract manufacturers, and internal sites.
* Experience identifying and implementing advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and capacity expansions to meet demanding customer ramps.
* undefined
* Demonstrated success leading across multiple business units in a matrixed organization; multi-BU or IDEX experience preferred.
* Strong business acumen in make-versus-buy, multi-site manufacturing, CapEx, tooling, cost, capacity, and risk decisions.
* Builds metrics, dashboards, and operating cadence that drive accountability and measurable results.
* Influential leader able to align executives, BU partners, and suppliers, and hold owners accountable without direct authority.
* Strong executive communicator who turns complex program information into clear decisions and actions.
* Experience with welding/joining, filtration, pneumatics, fluid handling, pumps, compressors, blowers, valves, electromechanical products, precision manufacturing, data center, thermal management, or engineered industrial components preferred.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP certification preferred; working knowledge of the IDEX Operating Model and 80/20 a plus.
* Proficient with project management tools, dashboards, and Microsoft Office applications.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations, supply chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of program management, NPD, manufacturing launch, quality, or operations experience, including 5+ years leading teams, with experience in industrialization, supplier development, site transfers, and multi-site manufacturing.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to move around and be still, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear.
* Employee will occasionally lift up to 35 lbs.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Develop leaders and employees through coaching, succession planning, workforce development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Utilize KPIs and operational metrics to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive sustainable business improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar senior manufacturing leader.
* Proven success managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve and sustain performance targets in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and operational expenses.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Experience supporting or maintaining IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified Manufacturing Manager (CMfgM), PMP certification, or similar professional credentials.
* Master's degree in a related discipline.

Why you'll want to join our team:

* Lead a critical manufacturing operation with broad operational responsibility.
* Make a meaningful impact on plant performance, customer satisfaction, and company growth.
* Partner with an experienced leadership team in a collaborative environment.
* Drive operational excellence and shape the future of the facility.
* Develop and mentor the next generation of manufacturing leaders.
* Influence strategic initiatives, capital investments, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive benefits and salary package being offered for this role.

This position is based on-site in Warren, MI and requires a strong presence on the production floor. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, supplier visits, training, and corporate initiatives.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

Job Type: Full time - Permanent

Location: Bethel, CT📍

A global, private equity backed medical device contract manufacturer is growing fast. With around 20 ISO 13485 certified sites, they make the precision components and sub-assemblies inside many of the world's leading medical devices, from laser-processed nitinol to thin-wall tubing. They're now looking for a Director of Quality to lead product quality and QMS compliance at one of their largest manufacturing sites.

**What you'll do:**

* Own manufacturing quality performance end to end, partnering with Operations to build quality into daily production
* Drive SPC, process capability and data-led problem solving directly on the manufacturing floor
* Lead validation strategy (IQ/OQ/PQ) and quality for New Product Introduction, from development into full-scale production
* Keep the QMS inspection-ready against ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820, and host FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Be the senior quality contact for high-visibility customers and lead the supplier quality program
* Build, mentor and train a quality team in tools like pFMEA, Gage R&R, RCA and CAPA

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or management
* 7+ years in a medical device quality management role
* Hands-on manufacturing quality leadership in an ISO 13485 / 21 CFR 820 environment
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Contract manufacturing, finished device assembly, sterilization oversight, eQMS / ERP and CQA (preferred)
* Willingness to travel around 25%

This is a chance to lead quality at a flagship site within a high-growth medtech manufacturer, with real influence on how quality scales across a global network.

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Production Operations
identity_held_roles.description:
**Sierra Space Careers:**
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.
 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.
 
 
Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.
 
 
We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.
 
 
**About The Role**
Sierra Space is scaling from development programs into high-rate, repeatable production across a diversified portfolio of military and commercial systems, including satellites and spacecraft, propulsion systems, solar power systems, and the Dream Chaser spaceplane. As Director, Production Operations based in Madison, Wisconsin, you will play a critical role in executing the production strategy for propulsion development and manufacturing, building the operational systems required to deliver hardware at pace, at quality, and at cost.
 
 
This is an execution-focused leadership role for a proven operations professional with expertise in propulsion systems. Reporting to the Vice President, Production, you will lead manufacturing and assembly operations for propulsion product lines and additional enterprise products within Sierra Space's Madison facility. You will drive standardization of production processes, implement data-driven manufacturing systems, and build high-performing teams capable of scaling propulsion output while maintaining quality and efficiency. You will partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to ensure production readiness and on-time delivery of critical propulsion systems for space and defense applications.
 
 
**About You**
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.
 
 
We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead manufacturing and assembly operations for propulsion product lines, including day-to-day oversight of production floor activities, scheduling, and workflow management at the Madison, WI facility.
* Execute production strategy to scale propulsion manufacturing from development programs into repeatable, high-rate production with a focus on throughput, yield, and cost efficiency.
* Standardize propulsion production processes and workflows to create consistent, repeatable, high-quality build operations aligned with enterprise-wide best practices.
* Support capacity planning and facility buildout efforts for propulsion manufacturing, including layout optimization, equipment installation, and production line commissioning.
* Drive vertical integration initiatives by standing up and maturing internal propulsion manufacturing capabilities, including additive manufacturing, machining, assembly, and test operations for propulsion components and systems.
* Implement and mature manufacturing execution systems (MES) and production data infrastructure to enable traceability, repeatability, and real-time visibility into propulsion manufacturing performance.
* Establish and maintain production operating rhythm through KPIs, dashboards, and review cadences focused on cycle time, yield, throughput, labor efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost for propulsion production.
* Apply lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) to identify and eliminate production inefficiencies, reduce waste, and improve quality in propulsion operations.
* Collaborate with Propulsion Engineering and Product Assurance to drive design-for-manufacturing (DFM) and design-for-test (DFT) into propulsion product development and support new product introduction (NPI) activities.
* Partner across Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, Security, and Program Management to ensure aligned production readiness, material availability, and execution against propulsion program schedules.
* Manage production budgets for propulsion operations and analyze manufacturing costs to implement cost-saving measures that maintain quality standards and support financial goals.
* Lead and develop production management teams at the Madison facility, including supervisors, engineers, and technicians, fostering collaboration and accountability while upholding company values and a culture of operational excellence.
* Ensure compliance with industry-specific production standards, safety regulations, and quality management systems (ISO, AS9100, GMP, etc.) applicable to aerospace and propulsion manufacturing operations.
* Represent propulsion production operations in cross-functional forums and communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to executive leadership and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory bodies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, or operations roles in complex technical industries, with a significant portion in leadership positions.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required
* Proven track record of successfully managing large teams and complex production projects in high-rate manufacturing environments.
* Strong background in manufacturing processes, assembly & integration, and operational execution for complex electromechanical or aerospace systems, with emphasis on propulsion systems preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and scaling production operations, including process standardization, workflow optimization, and capacity planning.
* Experience with data-driven manufacturing systems, MES, and production management processes, including OKR development and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of design-for-manufacturing (DFM) principles and ability to collaborate with engineering teams to optimize product designs for production.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and drive operational excellence in fast-paced, highly technical environments.
* Expertise in continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) with proven ability to identify and eliminate production inefficiencies.
* Strong financial acumen with demonstrated ability to manage production budgets, analyze manufacturing costs, and implement cost-saving measures.
* In-depth knowledge of industry-specific production standards, safety regulations, and quality management systems (ISO, AS9100, GMP, etc.).
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to represent production interests effectively to executive leadership and external stakeholders.
* Ability to uphold and model company values while holding others accountable and fostering a culture of operational excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in propulsion manufacturing and test operations, including liquid or hybrid rocket engines, thrusters, or propulsion subsystems.
* Familiarity with additive manufacturing (3D printing) for propulsion components, including metal printing processes and post-processing.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite, launch, or high-rate hardware manufacturing across both military and commercial product lines.
* Experience with vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities such as propulsion, fluid systems, PCBAs, structures, or integrated vehicle production.
* Experience with spacecraft or satellite integration and production.
* Familiarity with classified manufacturing and secure production operations.
* Experience implementing lean or continuous-improvement frameworks at scale in production environments.
* Experience with automated manufacturing, MES implementation, or production data systems.
* Experience leading organizational change initiatives specific to production environments, including technology implementation, process redesign, and workforce development.
* Experience building and scaling production teams during periods of rapid company growth.
* Master's degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.

Compensation:
 
 
Pay Range:
 
 
$164,513.00 - $226,205.00
 
 
Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.
 
 
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance.  The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.

identity_held_roles.title: Plant Manager
identity_held_roles.description:
Job ID: 530933

Ash Grove is a CRH company with a legacy dating back to 1882. We combine technical expertise, safety and customer-focused solutions to deliver reliable performance for our customers. We manufacture and supply high-performance, advanced cementitious materials for the most demanding construction and infrastructure needs. With more than 2,000 people across 60 locations in the United States and Canada, we support a wide range of applications, from major infrastructure projects to the development and refurbishment of residential and non-residential buildings that support everyday life, from highways and bridges to schools and commercial buildings.

To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.

**Job Location**

* This role will work out of our plant in Louisville, NE.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.

**Job Requirements**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy

**What CRH Offers You**

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

**About CRH**

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

EOE/Vet/Disability

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

identity_held_roles.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations
identity_held_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The
**Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations**
is a highly visible leadership role within the Member & Client Services Engineering (MCSE) organization at CVS Health. This position is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and operational excellence of business-critical platforms that support millions of members, customer service operations, clinical services, and enterprise applications. In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, observability, incident management, and operational automation across a complex technology ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and managed service providers to deliver highly reliable, scalable, and resilient technology solutions that support CVS Health's mission.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with experience driving reliability engineering practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in large-scale enterprise environments. You will play a key role in advancing modern SRE capabilities, including AI-driven operations (AIOps), observability, automation, and proactive service reliability initiatives. As a people leader, you will build and develop high-performing teams, influence strategic technology decisions, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. This role requires a passion for solving complex operational challenges, improving customer experiences, and driving measurable business outcomes through technology excellence.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Leadership
* Execute and advance the enterprise SRE strategy, including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and reliability roadmaps.
* Establish reliability standards and best practices across applications, APIs, data platforms, and emerging AI-powered solutions.
* Champion a culture of reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
* Drive platform resiliency, scalability, performance, and risk mitigation initiatives.

**AI-Driven Operations (AIOps) & Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AIOps capabilities to improve proactive issue detection, predictive analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Implement AI-assisted incident management, automated remediation, self-healing capabilities, and standardized operational runbooks.
* Partner with AI and platform engineering teams to integrate machine learning and generative AI technologies into operational workflows.

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Define and lead the enterprise observability strategy across metrics, logs, traces, and user experience monitoring.
* Drive standardization and adoption of observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Deliver actionable insights, dashboards, and executive reporting related to platform health, availability, performance, and reliability metrics.

**Incident Management & Operational Excellence**

* Lead enterprise incident response, escalation management, and post-incident reviews.
* Reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Restore (MTTR), and recurring incidents through automation and preventive engineering practices.
* Establish operational readiness standards, on-call processes, and service management best practices.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, and long-term service stability initiatives.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead high-performing global SRE and operations teams.
* Develop career growth frameworks, skill development programs, and technical leadership capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Partner with stakeholders across technology and business organizations to align reliability priorities with business objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* 10+ or more years of production support or service delivery experience.
* Experience working with a managed services vendor.
* ITIL Qualified & Expert knowledge of ITIL disciplines.
* Experience of managing 3rd parties and 3rd party delivered services.
* Service Management or Support in a large-scale and diverse environment of incident management, escalation procedures and related disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* High degree of self-motivation to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment.
* Strong communication skills are required to facilitate meetings with both technical and business audiences, often across multiple functional departments.
* Demonstrated understanding of various technologies (Java/J2EE, .Net, MQ, Mainframe, Telephony systems etc.)
* Experience with major database management systems, e.g. DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience creatively debugging complex system problems spanning entire hosting stack (application, server, communication channels, networking components, etc), resulting in problem determination and restoration through thorough research and fact finding.
* Be able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.
* Experience supporting both proprietary and vendor developed or supported applications.
* Demonstrated successful completion of technical projects.
* Demonstrated proficiency working on all phases of SDLC.
* Able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* ITIL certified

**Pay Range**
**The Typical Pay Range For This Role Is**
$106,605.00 - $213,210.00
 
 
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.
 
 
Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.
 
 
**Great Benefits For Great People**
We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.
 
 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.
 
 
Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.
 
 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/30/2026
 
 
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

identity_held_roles.title: R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager, Project Management
identity_held_roles.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

**What You Will Experience In This Position**

The R&D NPI Engineering Senior Manager will be a strategic and hands-on leader who drives on-time delivery and best practices for our new product introduction (NPI) programs within our Data Solutions business. This role will lead, coach and mentor a team of project and program managers to ensure alignment with business goals through effective portfolio and process management. The manager will work closely with business unit leaders, product managers, and engineering leaders to drive and improve on-time delivery and cross-functional collaboration for our portfolio of NPI programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development:**
Lead, mentor and inspire a high-performing, global project management team specializing in NPI Program execution. Develop a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and empower the team to drive excellence in project delivery.

**NPI Execution and Delivery:**
Oversee end-to-end execution of projects, ensuring on-time delivery, within scope and on budget while maintaining high quality outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**
Partner closely with engineering, product management, integrated supply chain, manufacturing and operations teams to ensure alignment of project priorities, resources, and timelines, facilitating seamless execution of programs.

**Resource Allocation:**
Optimize resource planning and allocation across projects, balancing capacity dynamically to meet changing business priorities and ensure effective utilization

**Portfolio Management:**
Collaborate with key partners to drive the selection and prioritization of NPI projects, connected to our strategic objectives and business goals.

**Continuous Improvement**
: Own and evolve the NPI phase-gate process to ensure consistent and efficient product development lifecycle execution. Drive continuous evaluation and enhancement of our project management processes, tools and methodologies to improve efficiency and scalability of programs.

**Performance & Reporting:**
Define and track KPIs to measure project health and business impact. Lead monthly business reviews to communicate progress, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Ideally 10+ years of proven experience in NPI or PMO leadership roles, preferably in data or technology-driven environments of which 2+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams
* Proven record of leading large-scale, complex projects and driving successful product introductions
* Proficiency in demonstrating expertise in PMO practices, methodologies, tools and processes.
* Outstanding ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive results in a matrixed organization.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making abilities to drive efficiency and optimize project outcomes.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, or engineering focused organizations

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
* nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
* Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.
* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work
* We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
* Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Pay Transparency**

nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply.

**Compensation Range**

$123,500.00 - $229,500.00

Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives.

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement
identity_held_roles.description:
**Compensation Data**
**Company Overview**
For more than 70 years, TBC Corporation has been a leader in the mobility industry and one of North America’s largest marketers and distributors of automotive replacement tires through wholesale operations. Additionally, TBC responds to the needs of consumers in search of total car care at nearly 470 franchised tire and automotive service centers under the award-winning Big O Tires® brand. TBC is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.
 
 
With $5 billion in revenue and more than 3,000 employees in the U.S. and Mexico, TBC markets on a wholesale basis to regional tire chains and distributors serving independent tire dealers and with proprietary brands of tires specializing in passenger, commercial, farm and specialty tires. In 2005, TBC Corp. was purchased by Sumitomo Corporation of America (SCOA). SCOA is the largest subsidiary of Sumitomo Corporation, one of Japan’s major integrated trading and investment business enterprises. In 2018, Michelin, the largest tire manufacturer in Europe, invested in the company which is now a 50:50, privately held joint venture between Sumitomo and Michelin.
 
 
Our Values Are The Foundation Of Our Work, How We Interact With Each Other, And The Strategies We Employ To Fulfill Our Purpose. These Are The Practices We Use Every Day – In Everything We Do
 
 

* Integrity - We act honestly because nothing is more important than our reputation.
* Teamwork - We are better together.
* People-Focused - We put people first – our Associates, customers, franchisees, and partners – and cultivate a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive culture, top to bottom, inside and out.
* Accountability - We own our actions and decisions; we do what we say we are going to do.
* Leave Everything Better - We innovate to improve everything we touch, and we take actions now to protect the future.

**Description**
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead an enterprise-wide supply chain continuous improvement strategy aligned with corporate objectives and growth priorities.
* Design, implement, and sustain a standardized continuous improvement framework across all supply chain functions.
* Establish governance processes, project selection criteria, performance review cadences, and accountability mechanisms.
* Build and maintain a sustainable pipeline of initiatives that improve productivity, reduce costs, enhance quality, and strengthen service delivery.
* Develop annual and multi-year operational excellence roadmaps that define priorities, milestones, and expected outcomes.
* Partner with distribution leadership to identify and eliminate operational inefficiencies across the distribution network.
* Improve labor productivity, throughput, inventory accuracy, storage utilization, order fulfillment, and service levels.
* Standardize best practices, workflows, operating procedures, and performance metrics across all distribution centers.
* Lead value stream mapping and process optimization efforts to increase operational effectiveness and capacity utilization.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Support automation, technology, and warehouse optimization initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability.
* Partner with transportation and logistics leadership to optimize international, domestic, and final-mile operations.
* Identify freight savings opportunities and improve transportation efficiency across ocean, air, drayage, truckload, less-than-truckload, parcel, and final-mile delivery operations.
* Reduce transportation costs while maintaining or improving customer service levels.
* Collaborate with planning teams to improve forecast accuracy, inventory deployment, replenishment strategies, and sales and operations planning processes.
* Identify and implement process improvements that increase inventory turns, service levels, and working capital performance.
* Develop standardized planning processes and performance measures.
* Partner with customer service leadership to improve the customer experience, order accuracy, responsiveness, and issue resolution.
* Implement process improvements that enhance service quality while reducing costs and eliminating non-value-added activities.

**Continued Responsibilities**

* Partner with safety leadership to embed safety principles into all continuous improvement programs and initiatives.
* Lead initiatives that reduce workplace incidents, strengthen compliance, and reinforce a culture of safety.
* Develop and manage a portfolio of projects focused on reducing operating expenses and improving productivity.
* Quantify project benefits and ensure financial results are accurately tracked, validated, and reported.
* Support annual budgeting and strategic planning by identifying opportunities to exceed financial targets.
* Partner with Regional Managing Directors to identify improvement opportunities and develop tactical action plans that deliver better-than-budget performance.
* Facilitate operational reviews, root cause analyses, and performance improvement workshops.
* Guide regional leadership teams in prioritizing initiatives with the greatest operational and financial impact.

**Added Responsibilities**

* Provide coaching, guidance, and project support to enable the successful execution and sustainment of improvement initiatives.
* Champion a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Develop training programs and continuous improvement toolkits that build organizational capability.
* Facilitate Kaizen events, continuous improvement workshops, and leadership development programs.
* Coach managers and functional leaders in Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Promote the adoption and consistent application of best practices across U.S. and Mexico operations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive supply chain, operations, logistics, or continuous improvement leadership experience.
* Experience leading enterprise-wide continuous improvement programs within a large-scale distribution, logistics, retail, manufacturing, or wholesale environment.
* Experience supporting multi-site operations with geographically dispersed facilities.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, transportation, planning, customer service, and safety functions.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives with measurable financial and operational results.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.
* APICS/ASCM Certifications (CPIM, CSCP, CLTD) preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

**Benefits**

* Market competitive compensation
* 401(k) and Roth with company match. Immediate 100% vesting
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental and vision
* Company paid short term disability and employer subsidized long term disability
* Company paid life insurance
* Discounted tire purchasing
* Tuition reimbursement
* Employee assistance program
* Generous paid vacation and paid time off
* Customizable voluntary benefits
* and More!!!

identity_held_roles.description:
**Director, Manufacturing Value Stream**
Global Value Stream As a Director on the Global Value Stream team, you will
*lead*
our Manufacturing value stream within HelloFresh's global supply chain, shaping the strategy and execution model for how we standardize, improve, and scale our operations worldwide. You will lead a team, set the department's operational agenda, and serve as a senior voice of operations across the organization. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of operations, technology, and global strategy.
 
 
***You will...***

* Define and execute the strategic direction for the portfolio of Manufacturing processes, owning the multi-year capability roadmap and global template.
* Lead and build a high-performing, accountable department with clear OKRs aligned to company strategy.
* Set the governance framework and operating model for how the Global Value Stream team designs, validates, and deploys process and technology standards internationally.
* Partner at the executive level with Operations, Product, Engineering, and others to align on global priorities, technology investments, and performance benchmarks.
* Serve as the final decision authority on process deviation requests, capability exceptions, and cross-market design trade-offs.
* Drive the organization's approach to continuous improvement, value stream analysis, and waste elimination at scale — setting the standard for how the company approaches process maturity.
* Ensure the team functions as an effective internal consultancy — providing rigorous expert support to regional operations, quality teams, and technology partners.

***You have...***

* 12–15+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing — including significant senior leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading multi-functional teams across multiple geographies, with full accountability for operational outcomes.
* Deep expertise across multiple supply chain functional domains, with a breadth of experience that enables credible leadership across the full Value Stream portfolio.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience managing department budgets and delivering measurable business impact.
* Extensive experience with global process standardization, operational technology ecosystems (WMS/WES/WCS/automation), and large-scale transformation programs.
* A track record of developing senior talent and building high-performance organizations.
* Experience operating as a senior stakeholder in cross-functional governance and product/technology lifecycle processes.
* Ability to travel up to 25%

***You are...***

* A bold, strategic leader with the operational depth to earn the trust of both warehouse teams and the C-suite.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity at the department level while maintaining clarity and pace for your team.
* A talent multiplier — known for developing strong leaders and creating organizations that outlast any individual.
* A rigorous, data-driven decision maker who moves fast without sacrificing quality or thoroughness.
* Passionate about building world-class operations at scale — energized by the complexity and impact of a global mandate.
* An outstanding communicator and influencer who can drive alignment across diverse cultures, functions, and levels of seniority.

**Additionally With This Role, You Will Have....**

* The opportunity to shape global operations at a leading food technology company with significant reach and impact.
* A high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
* Flexible working arrangements to support your work-life balance.
* Continuous development through HelloFresh Academies and access to internal mobility across 18 countries.
* An egoless, collaborative culture focused on learning, growth, and building something exceptional together.

***You’ll get…***

* Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
* Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
* Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
* Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor\_)
* Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
* Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.
 
 
**FOR CO POSTINGS**
*Our company is committed to fair hiring practices and complies with all applicable laws, including the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act (JAFA). In accordance with JAFA, we will not request your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution on your initial application for employment.*
**Education**
*When submitting supporting documents such as a resume, curriculum vitae (CV), or educational transcripts, you may voluntarily redact or omit any information that would identify your age. This includes:*

* Dates of birth
* Dates of attendance at educational institutions
* Dates of graduation

*Your decision to redact this information will not adversely affect the consideration of your application. We evaluate all candidates based on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Please be aware that should you receive a conditional offer of employment, we may be required to request this information for legally permissible purposes, such as verifying eligibility for employment or for benefits administration and background checks.*

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Quality Management
identity_held_roles.description:
**Benefits:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Quality Management – APS is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the enterprise quality management program across all APS services. This role ensures service excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction through standardized processes, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.

This leader partners with enterprise functions and operational stakeholders to document, standardize, and scale quality-of-service delivery across current and future APS sites. Responsibilities include developing quality frameworks, policies, playbooks, training programs, and performance reporting while driving actionable improvements aligned with APS Operating System, company initiatives and industry best practices.

To design, implement, and sustain a comprehensive quality management system that enhances efficiency, performance, and consistency across APS services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, APS Operating System, ABM standards, and client commitments. The role promotes a culture of continuous improvement and leverages technology and data to support operational excellence and client retention.

* Develop and execute an enterprise quality strategy aligned with APS Operating System, and ABM business objectives.
* Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program, including standards, governance, measurement frameworks, training, audits, and reporting.
* Establish and enforce quality control standards across all APS service lines.
* Lead audits and assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety, environmental, and industry standards (e.g., OSHA, ISO, APPA).
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and cost performance.
* Collaborate with Client Experience and operational leaders to drive consistency and improve customer satisfaction.
* Develop KPIs and reporting to provide insights to senior leadership.
* Build training programs and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Support special projectsand additional responsibilities as assigned.

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Facility Management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO) preferred.
* 8–10 years of quality management experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience with enterprise systems supporting the built environment (CMMS, BAS, BMS, IWMS).
* Proficiency in data analysis and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, VR, and smart building solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to lead change in a matrixed environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

 

ABM is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including disability and protected veteran status. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888-328-8606. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

 

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.

 

ABM is a military-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post-military career opportunities across ABM.

 

ABM directs all applicants to apply at www.abm.com/careers. ABM does not accept unsolicited resumes or submissions outside of this portal. Applicants should submit their application by clicking Apply Now.

For more information, visit www.abm.com
