identity_held_roles.title: General Manager/President – Precision Manufacturing
identity_held_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

American Photonics, a portfolio company of BlueRock Global, is a precision optical manufacturer serving the aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, scientific, and commercial markets.

We are strengthening our manufacturing capabilities, investing in operational improvements, and expanding into higher-value precision optics and infrared applications.

We operate in a technically demanding manufacturing environment where quality, precision, accountability, and reliable execution are essential. Our focus is on building a stronger, more capable manufacturing business positioned for sustainable, profitable growth.

**Job Overview**

American Photonics is seeking an accomplished General Manager to lead overall business performance, manufacturing operations, and organizational development.

This is the senior on-site executive position, with direct responsibility for operating P&L performance and leadership across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and supporting business functions.

The ideal candidate has successfully led a technically complex manufacturing business, improved financial and operational results, developed accountable leadership teams, and executed meaningful business improvements.

We are looking for a decisive, hands-on leader who understands both the financial and operational sides of manufacturing. This individual must be equally comfortable reviewing business performance, resolving production challenges, developing customer relationships, and working directly with employees on the manufacturing floor.

Reporting to ownership, the General Manager will have responsibility for translating strategic objectives into achievable operating plans, establishing clear accountability, and delivering measurable results. The position will work closely with BlueRock's corporate resources while maintaining ownership of day-to-day business execution.

**Duties**

* Assume accountability for operating P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, working capital, and achievement of financial objectives.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, workforce plans, and capital investment priorities aligned with business objectives.
* Lead Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and business operations to ensure coordinated execution and achievement of company objectives.
* Improve manufacturing performance through effective production planning, scheduling, labor utilization, material readiness, equipment effectiveness, and capacity management.
* Identify and resolve operational inefficiencies, production bottlenecks, excess costs, scrap, rework, quality issues, and sources of margin erosion.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance metrics, reporting standards, and management accountability for results.
* Strengthen job costing, pricing discipline, inventory control, purchasing practices, and financial visibility to support profitable decision-making.
* Lead and develop department managers, establish clear responsibilities and decision-making authority, address performance gaps, and build a capable, accountable leadership team.
* Partner with Sales and Engineering to evaluate customer opportunities, improve quoting accuracy, assess technical and manufacturing feasibility, and support profitable business growth.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with key customers, suppliers, strategic partners, and other business stakeholders.
* Improve ERP utilization, operational reporting, inventory accuracy, manufacturing documentation, and process controls to support efficient and scalable operations.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities, equipment investments, facility requirements, and process improvements based on operational needs, financial returns, and long-term business value.
* Maintain effective quality management systems, product traceability, corrective action processes, workplace safety standards, and compliance with applicable customer and regulatory requirements.
* Provide ownership with timely, accurate reporting on financial performance, operational results, business risks, and progress against established priorities.
* Lead organizational and operational changes with sound judgment, clear communication, and a consistent focus on employee engagement, accountability, and execution.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in precision, high-tolerance, or technically complex manufacturing environments.
* At least five years in a senior manufacturing leadership role, such as General Manager, Business Unit Leader, President, VP of Operations, or equivalent, with substantial financial and operational accountability.
* Demonstrated responsibility for a manufacturing business or business-unit P&L, including budgets, profitability, cost management, and operating performance.
* Proven success improving manufacturing profitability, productivity, operational efficiency, delivery performance, or organizational effectiveness, supported by measurable results.
* Experience leading cross-functional manufacturing teams, including Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and related business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to develop managers, establish performance expectations, manage organizational change, and hold teams accountable.
* Experience managing manufacturing operations involving complex processes, demanding quality standards, and customer-specific requirements.
* Strong business judgment, financial acumen, and the ability to make timely decisions based on operational and financial information.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant executive manufacturing experience.
* Ability to work full-time, on-site in Sarasota, Florida.

**Preferred**

* Leadership experience in precision optics, infrared optics, photonics, optical components, precision machining, aerospace, or defense manufacturing.
* Experience improving or scaling a small to mid-sized manufacturing business, particularly within an entrepreneurial or private-equity-backed environment.
* Experience with ERP implementation, systems modernization, manufacturing cost accounting, or operational restructuring.
* Experience leading manufacturing capacity expansion, capital equipment investment, new product introduction, or business improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems, ITAR/export-control requirements, and regulated manufacturing environments.

**Compensation** will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated capabilities, and the responsibilities of the position.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

American Photonics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Join us to lead innovative manufacturing processes that make a difference! We value energetic leaders who thrive on strategic growth, operational excellence, and inspiring teams to achieve their best every day.

Pay: From $1.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Describe your experience leading precision, engineered, regulated, or technically complex manufacturing.
* This is an on-site in-person position, would commute be an issue?
* What is your earliest available start date?
* Describe the most recent manufacturing company you led, including its products, approximate revenue, employee count, and functions reporting to you.
* Describe the scope of your direct P&L responsibility, including the financial results and capital decisions you owned.
* Provide one example of a manufacturing business, market, customer base, or product line you helped grow. What actions did you lead, and what measurable results followed?
* Compensation is based on experience, demonstrated results, and capabilities. What are your salary expectations for this role?

Work Location: In person

identity_held_roles.title: Global Director of Manufacturing Engineering Services
identity_held_roles.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Creation Technologies is seeking a Director of Manufacturing Engineering Services to shape the future of engineering across our global manufacturing operations. This is an exciting opportunity to make an enterprise-wide impact by driving engineering strategy, advancing manufacturing capabilities, championing continuous improvement, and delivering innovative solutions within the dynamic Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) industry. This position offers the flexibility to work remotely while collaborating with talented engineering and operational teams across our global footprint. 
 
In this role, you will lead a diverse network of engineering leaders and technical professionals, transforming strategic vision into measurable business results. From advancing New Product Introduction (NPI) and Design for Excellence (DfX) initiatives to leveraging advanced analytics, emerging technologies, and best-in-class manufacturing practices, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Creation’s engineering capabilities and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are energized by solving complex challenges, building technical excellence, and driving meaningful organizational change, we want to hear from you!

**Responsibilities Include:**

 

* Provide global leadership for the Manufacturing Engineering Leaders and teams in development and execution of technology roadmaps
* Ownership and continuous improvement of global business processes including Configuration Management and Engineering Change Orders
* DfM capabilities including Valor DfM analysis, DfM Guidelines development, and best practices for the enterprise
* SMT, PTH, and Box Build/System Integration Routing Definitions, Assembly documents, and Work Instructions processes and tools 
 Procurement Specifications developed in conjunction with Customer and Supply Chain team members
* Product Lifecycle Management processes and tools
* Manage Product Environmental Compliance capabilities and requirements in conjunction with Customer and Quality Assurance team members
* Management of global supplier relationships with various Engineering service and software providers including related negotiations
* Manages the engineering software validation process for PLM, MES, DfX, NPI, Component Data Intelligence and other key applications 
 Works with all site and regional technical and business teams to develop, share, and implement best practices
* Represents the needs from the Manufacturing Engineering team to executive strategic, tactical, and operational

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Required Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Computer, or Computer Science) is required
* Minimum of 15 years of related experience in a senior leadership and multi-site responsibility role
* Advanced degree in Engineering Management or Business Administration preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years’ experience in Electronics manufacturing of high-reliability PCBA sub-assemblies, assemblies, and system level products

**Skills Required:**

 

* Extensive applied manufacturing experience in Aerospace & Defense, Medical, and Tech Industrial products manufacturing (Highly preferred)
* Familiar with the product life development cycle for NPIs including Planning, Prototype, Qualification, and Ramp to sustaining volume production (Highly preferred)
* Proven analytical, problem-solving skills, and use of advanced statistical tools
* Strong technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to solve problems and clearly communicate topics of high technical content across various audiences including customers
* Demonstrated ability to identify & implement best practices
* Proven leadership and project management experience
* Excellent presentation skills and experience in customer relations
* Strategic thinker with a strong learning mindset and passion to support and grow a unique culture
* Thrives on the challenges of continuous improvement
* Driven by a high degree of integrity, with cultural and core value alignment to Creation
* Effective communication to interact effectively with all levels of the organization
* Entrepreneurial, creative and high-energy team player with the proven ability to balance competing priorities
* Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, FDA GMP Regulations, and Nadcap Process Certification

**Requirements:**

 

* Strong understanding of differences between IPC Class 1, 2 and 3 product build requirements.
* Knowledge of advanced Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles, tools, and methodologies
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt/Green Belt an asset 
 Engineering experience in printed circuit board or semiconductor manufacturing is a plus

In accordance with pay transparency regulations, the anticipated starting salary for this position ranges from $150k-$180k USD | CAD annually. Full-time employees are also eligible for performance-based bonuses and a range of benefits. Please note that this salary range is not guaranteed, and the final offer may vary based on experience, education, location, and shift. Additionally, the benefits and programs available may differ depending on the hire date, schedule type, and hours worked.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

Creation Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require any accommodations to complete the application process or need the job posting in an alternative format, please email Accessibility@creationtech.com. You will be connected with our Talent Acquisition team.

If you are contacted regarding the position, please inform our Talent Acquisition team of any accommodations you may need during the recruiting process. All information related to accommodation requests will be handled confidentially.

**Director of Quality**

This individual combines strategic vision with hands-on operational quality leadership, ensuring Resonetics delivers world-class quality in a fast-paced, highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The role demands proven experience within manufacturing operations, deep expertise in ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820, mastery of advanced quality assurance techniques, and the ability to align and elevate quality performance across multiple value streams.

Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.
  
  
Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.
  
  
**What You’ll Do As a Director Quality**

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:

+ Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
+ Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
+ Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
+ Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
+ Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
+ Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
+ Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
+ Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.

* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.

* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.

**Required**

* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.

The Global Director of Quality is responsible for oversight of Quality Management and Continuous Improvement Programs for Team Industrial Services globally. Position is responsible for managing and coordinating all Quality support activities relating to the execution of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Team Corporate, Product and Service Line, Engineering and Manufacturing, and Operations. Global Director of Quality is responsible for operating on a cost-effective basis within the framework of company approved policies, objectives, and budgets.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Maintains a safe, secure and healthy environment by adhering to Company/Customer safety and quality standards and practices and to legal regulations, alerting others regarding potential hazards or concern
* Adheres to and is a champion of TEAM’s Core Values
* Establish a continuous improvement culture across the enterprise utilizing known methods and concepts such as Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, Kaizen, Poka-yoke, CAPA, 8D, etc.
* Maintains contact with district, division and corporate levels to promote and instill a “Quality Culture” throughout the organization.
* Ensure TEAMs QMS is globally consistent and regionally precise based on local requirements.
* When necessary, provide training to affected personnel, including customers, to obtain maximum process efficiency, productivity, cooperation, and morale.

* Manage the Supplier Quality Management program and supports third-party and Customer assessments.

* Develops medium to long-term operating strategies and recommendations for plans and programs for increasing TEAM’s Quality performance.

* 15 years’ experience in Quality or Operational Excellence related function.
* Experience with problem solving methods such as A3, FMEA, etc. preferred.
* Experience in introducing/implementing a solid warranty tracking system that captures accurate Customer and or Field related issues.

**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
  
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

**About the Opportunity**

CoreWise is partnering with a growing industrial equipment manufacturer to identify a
**Director of Manufacturing**
who can lead its manufacturing operations through the next phase of growth.

Our client designs and manufactures complex, engineered-to-order industrial equipment. As production demands increase, the company is looking for an experienced manufacturing leader who can build strong teams, improve operational performance, and establish the processes and structure needed to scale.

This is an opportunity for someone who understands how to grow a manufacturing operation without sacrificing safety, quality, or workmanship.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing, the
**Director of Manufacturing**
will oversee daily manufacturing operations across multiple production departments, with responsibility for production performance, labor efficiency, quality, safety, and workforce development.

We're looking for a leader who is just as comfortable on the manufacturing floor as they are developing operational strategy. Someone who understands how to identify bottlenecks, develop frontline leaders, establish accountability, and translate business objectives into measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Manufacturing Operations**

* Oversee daily manufacturing operations, production schedules, capacity planning, and labor utilization to meet production and customer delivery commitments.
* Lead and develop production managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations and consistent production standards across departments.
* Improve coordination between production teams to maintain workflow and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Plan and implement multi-shift operations as production demands increase.

**Improve Operational Performance**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve labor efficiency, reduce costs, and expand manufacturing capacity.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, schedule attainment, rework, and on-time delivery.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies to standardize processes and improve performance.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes that support long-term business growth.

**Build and Develop Strong Teams**

* Coach and develop manufacturing managers and supervisors to become effective, independent leaders.
* Establish a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality workmanship.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing, succession planning, and employee development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, and supervisory coverage to meet operational needs.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, attendance, performance, and adherence to company policies.

**Champion Safety and Quality**

* Maintain a safe manufacturing environment in compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and applicable industry standards.
* Partner with Quality and Safety teams to reduce defects, rework, incidents, and operational risks.
* Ensure manufactured products consistently meet engineering specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions to prevent recurring production and quality issues.

**Manage Manufacturing Costs and Resources**

* Manage labor costs, overtime, productivity, and resource utilization.
* Partner with Finance and executive leadership on manufacturing budgets, capital expenditures, and cost-control initiatives.
* Evaluate equipment, facility, workforce, and technology needs to support increased production.
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing profitability through process improvements and effective resource allocation.

**Support Business Growth**

* Work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Management, Human Resources, and Finance to align manufacturing priorities.
* Address material availability, production readiness, and technical challenges that impact manufacturing performance.
* Support facility expansions, production transitions, and new product introductions.
* Provide executive leadership with regular updates on manufacturing performance, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior management or director-level role.
* Experience leading large-scale manufacturing operations with multiple production departments, managers, and supervisors.
* A demonstrated track record of improving production output, labor productivity, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, capacity management, manufacturing cost controls, and operational KPIs.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement initiatives, and standardized production processes.
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing reporting tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, growing manufacturing environment.
* A bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial equipment, HVAC, electrical integration, or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience overseeing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Technical familiarity with mechanical and electrical assembly, fabrication, and equipment testing.
* Experience scaling manufacturing operations during periods of significant growth.
* Experience supporting facility expansions, operational restructuring, or manufacturing transformations.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or related continuous improvement training.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production and on-time delivery targets are consistently met.
* Manufacturing capacity and labor productivity improve.
* Rework, defects, and production inefficiencies decrease.
* Safety standards are upheld throughout the manufacturing operation.
* Production managers and supervisors take ownership of their teams and performance.
* Labor and manufacturing costs are effectively managed as production grows.
* Manufacturing processes are established that support sustainable, long-term growth.

**About CoreWise**

CoreWise is a recruiting and workforce strategy partner that connects talented professionals with growing organizations. We are managing this search on behalf of our client and will work directly with qualified candidates throughout the recruiting process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Our client is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Please review the job details below.
  
  
Intuitive Machines - West is currently seeking a courageous, innovative, multi-skilled Director of High-Rate AIT Production to join our spacecraft production team in Palo Alto, CA.
  
  
**Life with Us**
Your Project: Intuitive Machines is a world leader in high-power spacecraft, having delivered some of the largest and highest-power spacecraft in the world. We are now looking to take this legacy of excellence to the next level, architecting a high-volume production line to build a large number of advanced spacecraft.
  
  
In this role, you will architect and implement a high-volume assembly, integration, and test (AIT) production line for these next-generation vehicles. You will be responsible for transforming our AIT operations from low-rate to high-rate production, establishing scalable processes and organizational capabilities to support our ambitious production targets. The scope includes complete spacecraft AIT from component receipt through final acceptance testing, encompassing electrical systems integration, solar array integration with the spacecraft bus, battery integration, advanced thermal solutions, and comprehensive environmental testing at production scale.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is developing an efficient, right-sized test program—one that provides high confidence the vehicles will perform as designed while eliminating non-value-added test activities that add cost and schedule without commensurate risk reduction. You will apply rigorous engineering judgment to distinguish between essential verification activities and legacy testing practices that may not be necessary for production-rate vehicles.
  
  
We are looking for leaders to bravely challenge conventional AIT approaches and establish production-rate processes for these advanced systems. You will play an essential role in applying design-for-manufacturing/design-for-test (DFM/DFT) principles to develop AIT specifications and manufacturing plans suitable for volume production. Additionally, you will represent AIT capabilities during customer proposal efforts, providing technical credibility and instilling confidence in our ability to execute high-volume production of complex spacecraft.
  
  
Your Career: We're very serious about professional development and continuing education at Intuitive Machines - West. We offer our team members the opportunity to define their own career trajectory. You will work with your manager to set goals and design a development plan to advance your career. This unique opportunity is a high-visibility role critical to our company's leadership position in spacecraft manufacturing.
  
  
What We Offer: Time for dedicated professional development, conference attendance, industry training, peer group collaboration, as well as paid certifications and education reimbursement.
  
  
Who you will work with: You will report to the VP of Spacecraft Production and Operations and collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams. You will lead a team of AIT production engineers and technicians while partnering with design engineering to ensure producibility of our spacecraft systems. You will also engage directly with potential customers during proposal phases to communicate our production and test capabilities.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end AIT production flow optimized for high-volume throughput
* Develop capacity models, takt time analysis, and process flow requirements for production-rate AIT
* Define capital equipment strategy including test equipment, handling systems, and tooling
* Establish scalable AIT work instructions, process controls, and quality gates
* Lead development of an efficient, risk-informed test program that ensures vehicle performance confidence while eliminating non-value-added testing
* Oversee spacecraft-level integration of solar arrays, batteries, and other major subsystems with the spacecraft bus
* Implement manufacturing execution systems (MES) tailored to provide assembly process documentation and production tracking for volume spacecraft production
* Define requirements for low-cost mechanical and electrical assembly, integration and test equipment, and production tooling
* Lead Voice of Manufacturing inputs to spacecraft design to ensure producibility at scale
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging lean manufacturing principles
* Build and mentor AIT production engineering team
* Represent AIT production capabilities to potential customers during proposal efforts, providing technical credibility on execution readiness
* Support business development with AIT cost models and production capacity commitments

**How You Will Be Evaluated**
Your performance will be measured against AIT production readiness milestones, test program efficiency metrics, production ramp targets, quality metrics, and cost per unit objectives.
  
  
**What We Look For In Team Members**
As a team member at Intuitive Machines - West, we expect you to demonstrate honesty, integrity, innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree
* Minimum of 15 years related aerospace manufacturing/AIT experience
* Minimum of 7 years leadership experience in production or manufacturing engineering
* Experience working cross-functionally within a company and/or with external partners and contractors
* Proven track record scaling aerospace production operations
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with volume production of spacecraft or complex aerospace systems
* Direct experience developing and implementing a spacecraft AIT production line
* Experience with large spacecraft systems (solar array integration, battery integration, high-voltage testing)
* Demonstrated experience developing efficient, risk-based test programs that balance verification rigor with schedule/cost efficiency
* Understanding of spacecraft environmental testing at production scale (thermal vacuum, vibration, EMI/EMC)
* Prior history as an AIT engineer, process engineer, or industrial engineer for aerospace products
* Experience with sustaining engineering processes such as Change Approval, NPI, breakpointing
* Advanced degree in a technical field
* Lean/Six Sigma certification
* Experience with AS9100 quality systems
* Capital project management experience (multi-million dollar equipment investments)
* Experience taking spacecraft products into production, including progressive design iterations to reduce delivered cost
* Demonstrated experience applying system engineering practices to AIT operations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging directly with customers in technical/proposal settings
* Experience working directly with customers in the commercial space industry
* Ability to work independently with a high degree of organization and attention to detail

**Company Description**
The Father’s Table is a privately owned national dessert manufacturer based in sunny Sanford, Florida, known for its innovation and extensive product lines. The company serves multiple channels, including national retail accounts, food service, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, and school lunch programs, reaching far beyond local bakeries. Its offerings range from grab-and-go convenience items to decadent, restaurant-quality desserts such as creamy cheesecakes and home-style cake rolls. A unique production process and strong company values have helped The Father’s Table become the #1 branded cheesecake in the retail in-store bakery segment. Applicants can learn more about the company by visiting www.thefatherstable.com.

**Director of Manufacturing**

Department: Operations Reports To: President ,Direct Reports: Plant Managers, Senior Manager of Cheesecake Production, Position Summary: The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and operational leadership across two manufacturing facilities overseeing approximately 1,000 employees. This role serves as the primary architect of operational excellence moving the organization toward more data-driven decisions. The Director standardizes processes, drives toward modern manufacturing systems (KPIs, OEE, ERP), ensures food safety, and champions the successful implementation and optimization of our core cheesecake production lines.

---

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. Change Management & Professionalization**

· Standardize Operations: Develop, implement, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) across both plants to ensure consistency in quality, safety, and efficiency.

· Cultivate Leadership: Mentor, coach, and upskill plant managers and front-line supervisors, shifting the culture from firefighting to proactive, structured problem-solving.

· Data-Driven Culture: Introduce and track rigorous key performance indicators (KPIs) and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metrics to guide daily, weekly, and monthly business reviews.

**2. Core Product Implementation & Optimization (Cheesecake Operations)**

· Product Optimization: Partner with the Senior Production Manager to evaluate all new cheesecake formulas, sizes, and configurations introduced into production.

· Constraint Assessment: Review new product introductions to assess potential issues or constraints affecting quality performance, labor efficiency, run rates, and operating costs.

· Executional Direction: Provide hands-on, "feet-on-the-floor" leadership to the operations team during major line optimizations, ERP system changes, and plant renovations.

**3. Food Safety, Quality & Compliance**

· Regulatory & Legality: Ensure both facilities strictly adhere to FDA, USDA, OSHA, and local regulations, taking ultimate responsibility for the safety and legality of all food products.

· Audit Readiness: Maintain "always audit-ready" standards for SQF, BRC, or other GFSI-benchmarked certifications and retail customer audits.

· Safety Culture: Champion a zero-injury safety culture through robust Hazard Identification, training, and behavioral safety programs.

4. Financial & Strategic Management

· P&L Responsibility: Manage the manufacturing budget, labor costs, variances, and operational expenses across both plants.

· CAPEX Planning: Identify, justify, and execute capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects aimed at automation, capacity expansion, and facility modernization.

**A Brief Summary Of This Position**
The Plant Manager is accountable for end-to-end operations of the Elkhart plant and for achieving Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) objectives. The incumbent provides leadership, direction, planning, and control across manufacturing, materials/purchasing, production scheduling, and shipping to ensure products are produced safely, meet customer and regulatory requirements, and are delivered complete and on time. This role drives continuous improvement and operational excellence, develops and coaches leaders, and manages budgets and cost controls to optimize productivity, quality performance, and overall plant profitability.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Ensure that all administrative, supervisory and hourly positions are staffed with the best qualified personnel available.
* Drive team engagement through regular coaching, feedback and involvement in day-to-day operations.
* Foster an environment of open communication.
* Maintain required professional competencies; assess staffing levels and capability; and develop direct reports through training and development opportunities.
* Empower all employees to seek and recommend work methods, tools and procedures to improve safety, quality, delivery and cost functions.
* Develop, coach, and hold leaders and teams accountable through clear expectations, training, and performance management.
* Enforce company policies and procedures in partnership with HR, the Site Controller and operational leadership.
* Lead and sustain a continuous improvement culture across all departments.
* Own site performance to Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) targets by setting expectations, reviewing results, and driving corrective actions with the Production and Materials team, including:

+ Safety: OSHA recordable incident rate (TRIR) and VSI leading indicators
+ Quality: CoPQ: Internal (scrap and rework) and External (customer defects/complaints)
+ Delivery: SCOT (Ship Complete On Time)
+ Cost: labor and overhead (burden) performance vs. budget/standard
+ Cost: operating profit / plant financial performance
+ Cost/Working Capital: inventory turns and inventory accuracy
+ Cost: manufacturing expense per earned hour / pcs (TME)

* Ensure equipment, processes, and behaviors comply with safety requirements.
* Maintain product quality standards and lead ongoing continuous improvement efforts related to quality.
* Ensure that production and shipment of product meets or exceeds the conformance and delivery expectations of product users and customers.
* Lead cross-functional alignment across sales/marketing, engineering, manufacturing, production control, and off-site operations to achieve SQDC commitments.
* Review daily/weekly SQDC performance and implement countermeasures to protect on-time shipment and cost targets.
* Communicate plant priorities, performance, and changes to hourly and salaried employees.
* Manage inventory to support SCOT while minimizing working capital and obsolescence.
* Oversee preventative maintenance systems in an effort to maintain and protect physical corporate assets.
* Ensure strong systems are in place and functioning to drive asset reliability.
* Lead site-level control activities by communicating expectations and ensuring alignment through a strong partnership with the site Controller.
* Recommend improvements to controls, monitor compliance, and provide accountability to senior management.

* Preferred Bachelors with 7+ years relevant experience or Associates Degree with 9+ years relevant experience or 11+ years of relevant experience
* Seven or more years of progressive management experience in a manufacturing environment
* Extensive experience with budget and cost management
* Working knowledge of all areas of production from material procurement, transformation, through to shipment
* Experience using MS Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to travel up to 10%, including overnights

**Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications**

* B.S. in Manufacturing, Business, Technology, or related field is preferred
* Master’s Degree
* Prior experience as a Plant Manager of a manufacturing facility

Work is typically performed in a manufacturing plant environment and the incumbent needs to be able to move about the office and production environments. There is often exposure to conditions such as dust, dirt, heat, fumes, and cold as well as noise levels above 80 decibels. Many aspects of this role are physical and the incumbent has to be able to lift up to 50 lbs. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. existing_roles.description:
**About Rivian**
Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.
  
  
As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a leader of a multi-disciplinary team of manufacturing engineers, you will be instrumental in launching new products and capacities at Rivian, transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities. This role sits at the intersection of product design, validation, factory design, and launch, ultimately delivering Rivian's best ideas into the hands of our customers. You will be responsible for leading and developing a motivated team of manufacturing SMEs in supporting all Rivian vehicle products and factories. This position is located at our Plymouth, MI headquarters or Georgia facility and will require significant travel to our manufacturing facilities in Normal, IL, and future locations. This role reports directly to the Director of Manufacturing Engineering in General Assembly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of manufacturing engineers responsible for designing and executing workstation design aligned with lean manufacturing principles. Workstation design supports overall plant metrics of 90 - 95% utilization and greater than 50 value added elements. Start to finish ownership of workstation design from virtual build through launch.
* Support Rivian manufacturing lines and sites and cover factory layout, manufacturing technology selection, equipment design, process design, etc.
* A special focus of this team will be advancing Rivian’s manufacturing technology and innovation roadmap
* Conduct virtual builds, support design validation builds of next generation products and provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly feedback, collaborating with vehicle architecture, design, software, and other upstream partners
* Define and execute launch and ramp strategies, collaborating with launch, operations, RPS, quality and design responsible teams
* Deliver production documentation such as JES, PFMEA, Control Plans etc.
* Develop and implement processes, standards and workflows to improve team efficiency
* Actively mentor and grow manufacturing engineers and managers through technical leadership, translate vision into action, inspiring from ideation to execution
* Actively engage in value engineering, challenge assumptions and break the status quo

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in an engineering role related to manufacturing engineering, DFMA, product optimization, manufacturing process or equipment development
* Expertise in manufacturing and industrial engineering principles (OEE, cycle time analysis, DVA, Cp/Cpk, GR&R, ergonomics, DOE, quality control, equipment selection, ROI, error proofing, supply chain & logistics)
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems using first principles, challenge assumptions and biased towards action
* Proven technical leader that can lead and influence cross-functional teams launching new products, lean manufacturing workstations and material flow processes
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, ability to concisely summarize and escalate complex topics
* Experienced working within 2D & 3D CAD environments, simulation tools and other digital tools in the field of engineering

**Pay Disclosure**
The salary range for this role is $161,000-$201,200 for Georgia and Michigan based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.
  
  
The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.
  
  
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.
  
  
You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 1/1/2027.
  
  
**Interview Integrity & AI Policy**
Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore,
**the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted**
. We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.
  
  
**Candidate Data Privacy and Technology**
Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.
  
  
Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.
  
  
Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.
  
  
How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.
  
  
AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.
  
  
Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.
  
  
**Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.**

**Job Description**
The Director PMO NPI/NPD is responsible for leading the successful transition of new products from R&D into scalable volume manufacturing. Sitting within the PMO and reporting to the VP of Production Engineering and Continuous Improvement (PECI), this role owns NPI execution, manufacturing readiness, and phase-gate milestone delivery across the product portfolio. The Director partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management to ensure products transition seamlessly into volume manufacturing — meeting customer, quality, cost, and delivery expectations — while building the processes, tooling, and team capabilities needed to scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**New Product Development & Launch**

* Own PLM milestone tracking, phase-gate execution, and portfolio pipeline alignment to ensure timely and effective product launches
* Drive product commercialization from R&D handoff through launch, ensuring new products meet or exceed customer, quality, cost, and delivery requirements
* Align cross-functionally on the new product pipeline and launch readiness across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management

**Manufacturing Readiness & Scale-Up**

* Lead the transition of products from R&D into volume manufacturing, establishing scalable and repeatable production processes
* Develop and ramp manufacturing capability and capacity for new products at the R&D site
* Establish and continuously improve the R&D production line to support prototype and pilot builds

**Automation, Tooling & Test**

* Lead automation initiatives including tooling, test fixtures, and production test requirement definition
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to ensure test and tooling solutions are scalable for volume production

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Program Managers and the Engineering Manager for Prototype and Pilot Builds
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the NPD PMO function

**Skill & Abilities**
**Ownership & Accountability**
Ability to drive NPI program outcomes from R&D handoff through volume manufacturing launch. Holds themselves and their team to commitments, drives decisions, and escalates risks proactively — ensuring programs stay on track.
  
  
**Program & Portfolio Management**
Ability to manage multiple NPI programs simultaneously across the portfolio, maintaining phase-gate discipline, milestone ownership, and pipeline visibility from commercialization through volume launch.
  
  
**Commercialization & NPI Execution**
Ability to take products through the commercialization phase — from R&D handoff to volume manufacturing — on time and within cost, quality, and delivery targets.
  
  
**Manufacturing & Production Readiness**
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, scale-up requirements, tooling, automation, and test development — with the ability to translate R&D outputs into production-ready solutions.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence**
Ability to align and drive execution across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management without direct authority over all stakeholders — critical in a PMO structure.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Prioritization**
Ability to manage competing program priorities at the portfolio level, make sound trade-off decisions, and keep initiatives aligned to business objectives.
  
  
**Team Development**
Ability to lead, develop and effectively scale a team to ensure the right capabilities and resourcing are in place at the right time.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication & Reporting**
Ability to synthesize program status, risks, and decisions into clear, concise communication for senior leadership and the c-suite.
  
  
**Travel**
Ability to travel 10-20%
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field
* 15+ years of program management experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, with a focus on new product introduction (NPI), product transitions, or manufacturing scale-up
* 5+ years of team leadership/management role within a PMO, R&D, or Operations function
* Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production readiness, and product commercialization
* Familiarity with PLM systems and phase-gate product development processes
* PMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent certification

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA a plus
* Experience with automation systems, production tooling, and test fixture development
* Deep knowledge of phase-gate execution, PLM milestone management, and portfolio pipeline alignment
* Demonstrated success scaling products from prototype/pilot builds to volume manufacturing
* Experience building and developing technical teams in an R&D or pilot production environment

**What We Offer**

* Generous Paid Time Off – Enjoy 3 weeks of PTO annually, with accrual starting on day one.
* Comprehensive Health Coverage – United Healthcare medical plans available for both individuals and families, starting on the first day of hire in addition to Dental, Vision and Disability Insurance.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) – Purchase company stock at a 15% discount through convenient payroll deductions.
* 401(k) with Company Match –Receive a 50% match on contributions up to 8%, with immediate vesting so you fully own every dollar right away.
* Paid Holidays – 9 company holidays, plus a floating holiday.
* Tuition Reimbursement –Invest in your future with up to $7,500 per year for approved professional development.

*Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional job-related factors, including knowledge, skills, experience, tenure, and relevant education or training. The pay scale is subject to change depending on business needs. Your recruiter can share more about the specific range for your location during the hiring process.*

Our benefits are designed to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance, provide peace of mind, and prepare for your future. We offer medical, dental, and vision plans across all locations, allowing team members to select the coverage that best meets their healthcare needs and budget. Our benefits also include a paid time-off program and paid holidays to support your time away from work. A summary of our Benefits will be provided during the interview process.*

existing_roles.description:
**Director of Overseas Manufacturing and Quality**
**Chefman | Product Development | Mahwah, NJ**
**About Us**
Chefman is one of North America's leading brands of small kitchen appliances, committed to building best-in-class products that make cooking accessible and enjoyable. In 2020, we launched CHEF iQ, an ecosystem of connected smart kitchen appliances designed to transform how the world cooks through intuitive guided cooking experiences and IoT-enabled technology.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Chefman continues to scale, we're looking for a Director of Overseas Manufacturing and Quality to elevate how we partner with our overseas manufacturing network and ensure our growing product portfolio is built with the consistency and precision our customers expect.
  
  
This is not a desk job. We need a leader who has personally run a factory floor, someone who can walk into an assembly line, spot a process problem before it becomes a quality escape, and work directly with factory teams to fix it. You'll serve as the critical bridge between our design and product development teams here in Mahwah and our manufacturing partners in China, helping ensure that what we design translates seamlessly into what gets built at scale.
  
  
We're looking for a leader with deep, sustained manufacturing expertise, ideally 10 to 15 years building that expertise with one organization, who is ready to bring that experience to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial consumer brand. As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. Serving our core markets of Water & Process, Agricultural & Renewables, and Industrials, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive separation solutions precisely tailored to our clients' requirements. With a strong track record of strategic growth and acquisitions, Komline continues to expand its solution portfolio and technical capabilities while maintaining our commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

**This Opportunity**

The Director, Operational Excellence is responsible for building, deploying, and sustaining the Komline Business System (KBS), a consistent operating excellence system across all Komline sites. This leader will partner with Business Unit General Managers, Plant Managers, and functional leaders to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, working capital, productivity, and overall operating discipline while respecting the P&L accountability of each business. The role will lead Komline’s enterprise continuous improvement (CI) capability, develop CI talent, and ensure proven practices are shared and scaled across the network.

The successful candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who combines strong Lean expertise with business judgment, credibility on the shop floor, and the executive presence to influence decentralized business leaders. This leader will be equally comfortable coaching a plant team, challenging a site improvement plan, and communicating enterprise priorities to senior leadership.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this enterprise-wide role supports all Komline operating sites.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and lead implementation of the KBS Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, standards, and multi-year improvement agenda across all sites
* Lead, coach, and develop the CI Manager team and other improvement resources; establish clear site coverage, priorities, and deployment expectations
* Partner with GMs and Plant Managers to identify the highest-impact opportunities and build robust, financially validated site-level improvement pipelines that deliver sustained results in safety, productivity, delivery, lead time, quality, inventory, cost, and working capital
* Establish and sustain common Lean / KBS operating practices, including daily management, visual management, standard work, problem solving, RCCM, value-stream improvement, kaizen, and leader standard work
* Create a practical maturity assessment for Operational Excellence and use it to prioritize coaching, capability building, and site support; track improvements in maturity and consistent adoption of core operating practices
* Drive measurable productivity and capacity improvements through flow, labor optimization, constraint removal, setup reduction, layout improvement, and waste elimination
* Partner with Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, EHS, Finance, Engineering, HR, and other enterprise functions to quantify benefits and ensure improvements are sustained
* Build CI capability within site leadership and frontline teams through training, coaching, kaizen leadership, and development of local change agents
* Establish common operational KPI definitions and review routines that enable benchmarking and the sharing and scaling of best practices across Komline
* Support acquisition integration by assessing operational maturity, identifying improvement opportunities, and integrating acquired sites into Komline’s operating system
* Provide regular enterprise-level reporting to the COO on CI pipeline, benefits realization, site maturity, risks, and resource priorities
* Promote a culture of accountability, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong partnership with decentralized business leadership

* Demonstrated success leading Lean / continuous improvement across multiple sites or business units
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management, kaizen, standard work, value-stream mapping, structured problem solving, and performance management

* Experience with plant layout, flow optimization, capacity improvement, and working-capital initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical/operations degree
